a: Meematay korin et shema baaravin? mishshaa shehakkohanim nichnasim leechol bitrumatan. ad sof haashmura harishona. divre rabbi eliezer.
Vachachamim omrim: ad chatzot.
Rabban gamliel omer ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar.

Maase uvau vanav mibbet hammishte, amru lo: lo karinu et shema, amar lahem: im lo ala ammud hashshachar chayyayvin attem likrot. velo zo bilvad amru, ella kol ma sheamru chachamim "ad chatzot", mitzvatan ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar.

Hekter chalavim veevarim, mitzvatan ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar vechol hanneechalim leyom echad, mitzvatan ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. im ken, lama amru chachamim "ad chatzot" — kede leharechik adam min haavera:
Gemara tanna hecha kae dekatane "meematay"?
Vetu: may shena detane bearvit beresha? litne deshacharit beresha!
Tanna akkera kae, dichtiv: "beshachbecha uvekumecha". vehachi katane: zeman keriat shema dishchiva emat? — mishshaa shehakkohanim nichnasin leechol bitrumatan.
Vei baet ema: yalef mibberiyyayto shel olam, dichtiv: "vayhi erev vayhi voker yom echad".
I hachi, sefa dekatane "bashshachar mevarech shetayim lefaneha veachat leachareha, baerev mevarech shetayim lefaneha ushetayim leachareha", litne dearvit beresha!
Tanna patach bearvit, vahadar tane beshacharit, ad dekae beshacharit, paresh mille deshacharit, vahadar paresh mille dearvit.
Amar mar mishshaa shehakkohanim nichnasim leechol bitrumatan. mikkedi kohanim emat ka achli teruma? — mishsheat tzet hakkochavim, litne: "mishsheat tzet hakkochavim"!

Milleta aggav orcheh kamashma lan — kohanim emat ka achli bitruma — mishsheat tzet hakkochavim. veha kamashma lan dechappara la meakkeva. kidtanya: "uva hashshemesh vetaher" — biat shimsho meakkavto milleechol bitruma, veen kapparato meakkavto milleechol bitruma.
Umimmay dehay "uva hashshemesh" biat hashshemesh, vehay "vetaher" — tehar yoma.
b: Dilma biat oro hu, umay "vetaher" — tehar gavra?!
Amar rabbah bar rav shela: im ken, lema kera: "veyithar", may "vetaher" — tehar yoma, kidamri inashe: "iarav shimsha veiddakki yoma".
Bemaarava, ha derabbah bar rav shela la shemia lehu, uveo la mibbaya: hay "uva hashshemesh" biat shimsho hu, umay "vetaher" — tehar yoma, o dilma biat oro hu, umay "vetaher" — tehar gavra.
Vahadar pashtu la mibbarayyta. middekatane bevarayyta, siman laddavar — tzet hakkochavim. shema minna — biat shimsho hu, umay "vetaher" — tehar yoma.
Amar mar mishshaa shehakkohanim nichnasin leechol bitrumatan. ureminhu: meematay korin et shema baaravin — mishsheheani nichnas leechol pitto bemelach, ad shaa sheomed lippater mittoch seuddato.
Sefa, vadday peliga ammatnitin. resha, mi lema peligi ammatnitin?
La, ani vechohen chad shiura hu.

Ureminhu: meematay matchilin likrot keriat shema bearvit — mishshaa shebbene adam nichnasin leechol pittan bearve shabbatot, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: mishshaa shehakkohanim zakkain leechol bitrumatan. siman laddavar: tzet hakkochavim. veaf al pi sheen reaya laddavar, zecher laddavar, shenneemar: "vaanachnu osim bammelacha vechetzyam machazikim barmachim mealot hashshachar ad tzet hakkochavim", veomer: "vehayu lanu hallayla mishmar vehayyom melacha".
May "veomer"?
Vechi tema mikki arva shimsha, lelya hu, veinhu demachshechi umakdemi, ta shema "vehayu lanu hallayla mishmar vehayyom melacha".
Ka salka datach deani uvene adam chad shiura hu. vei amrat ani vechohen chad shiura hu, chachamim hayeynu rabbi meir?
Ella, shema minna ani shiura lechud vechohen shiura lechud. la, ani vechohen chad shiura hu, veani uvene adam lav chad shiura hu.

Veani vechohen chad shiura hu? ureminhu: meematay matchilin likrot shema baaravin — mishshaa shekkadash hayyom bearve shabbatot, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi yehoshua omer: mishshaa shehakkohanim metoharim leechol bitrumatan. rabbi meir omer, mishshaa shehakkohanim tovlin leechol bitrumatan. amar lo rabbi yehuda: vahalo kohanim mibbeod yom hem tovlim? rabbi chanina omer mishshaa sheani nichnas leechol pitto bemelach. rabbi achay veamri la rabbi acha omer: mishshaa sherov bene adam nichnasin lehasev.
Vei amrat ani vechohen chad shiura hu, rabbi chanina hayeynu rabbi yehoshua!
Ella lav shema minna shiura deani lechud veshiura dechohen lechud, shema minna.
He minnayyhu meuchar? mistabbera deani meuchar dei amrat deani mukedam rabbi chanina hayeynu rabbi eliezer. ella lav shema minna deani meuchar. shema minna.
Amar mar. amar leh rabbi yehuda: vahalo kohanim mibbeod yom hem tovlim!
Shappir kaamar leh rabbi yehuda lerabbi meir?

Verabbi meir hachi kaamar leh: mi savrat daana abben hashshemashot didach ka amena? ana abben hashshemashot derabbi yose ka amena, deamar rabbi yose ben hashshemashot keheref ayin, ze — nichnas, veze — yotze, vei efshar laamod alav.

a: Kashya derabbi meir adderabbi meir! tere tannae allibba derabbi meir.
Kashya derabbi eliezer adderabbi eliezer!
Tere tannae allibba derabbi eliezer, veibbaet ema: resha lav rabbi eliezer hi.
Ad sof haashmura.
May kasavar rabbi eliezer? i kasavar shalosh mishmarot have hallayla, lema "ad arba shaot". vei kasavar arba mishmarot have hallayla, lema "ad shalosh shaot"!

Leolam kasavar shalosh mishmarot have hallayla, veha kamashma lan: deikka mishmarot barakia veikka mishmarot beara. detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: shalosh mishmarot have hallayla, veal kol mishmar umishmar yoshev hakkadosh baruch hu veshoeg kaari, shenneemar: "Adonai mimmarom yishag, umimmeon kadsho yitten kolo shaog yishag al navehu".
Vesiman laddavar: mishmara rishona chamor noer, sheniyya kelavim tzoakim, shelishit, tinok yonek mishshede immo, veishsha mesapperet im baalah.
May ka chashev rabbi eliezer, i techillat mishmarot ka chashev — techillat mishmara rishona simana lema li? ureta hu! i sof mishmarot ka chashev, sof mishmara acharona lema li simana? yemama hu!
Ella: chashev sof mishmara rishona, utechillat mishmara acharona, veemtzait deemtzaita. veibbaet ema: kullehu sof mishmarot ka chashev, vechi tema acharona la tzerich.
Lemay nafka minna — lemikre keriat shema leman degane bevayit afel vela yada zeman keriat shema emat. kevan deishsha mesapperet im baalah vetinok yonek mishshede immo, likum velikre.

Amar rav yitzchak bar shemuel mishshemeh derav: shalosh mishmarot have hallayla, veal kol mishmar umishmar yoshev hakkadosh baruch hu veshoeg kaari, veomer: "oy shehecheravti et beti vesarafti et hechali vehigleti et banay leven ummot haolam".

Tanya, amar rabbi yose: paam achat hayiti mehallech badderech venichnasti lechureba achat mechurevot yerushalayim lehitpallel. ba eliyyahu zachur lattov veshamar li al happetach, (vehimtin li) ad shessiyyamti tefillati. leachar shessiyyamti tefillati amar li: "shalom alecha, rabbi". veamarti lo: "shalom alecha, rabbi umori". veamar li: beni, mippene ma nichnasta lechureba zo? amarti lo: lehitpallel. veamar li: haya lecha lehitpallel badderech. veamarti lo: mityare hayiti shemma yafsiku bi ovre derachim, veamar li haya lecha lehitpallel tefilla ketzara.
Beotah shaa lamadti mimmennu shelosha devarim: lamadti sheen nichnasin lechureba, velamadti shemmitpallelin badderech, velamadti shehammitpallel bederech mitpallel tefilla ketzara.

Veamar li: beni, ma kol shamata bechureba zo? veamarti lo: shamati bat kol shemmenahemet keyona veomeret: "oy shehecheravti et beti vesarafti et hechali vehigleti et banay leven ummot haolam". veamar li: chayyecha vechayye roshcha, lo shaa zo bilvad omeret kach, ella bechol yom vayom, shalosh peamim omeret kach. velo zo bilvad ella, beshaa sheyyisrael nichnasin levatte kenesiyyot ulevatte midrashot veonin "yehe shemeh haggadol mevorach", hakkadosh baruch hu menanea rosho, veomer: ashre hammelech shemmekallesin oto beveto kach, ma lo laav shehigla et banav, veoy lahem labbanim sheggalu meal shulechan avihem.
Tanu rabbanan, mippene shelosha devarim en nichnasin lechureba: mippene chashad, mippene hammappolet, umippene hammazzikin. "mippene chashad", vetippok leh "mishshum mappolet"?
b: Bechadti.
Vetippok leh mishshum mazzikin? bitre.
I bitre — chashad name lekka! bitre uferitzi.
"Mippene hammappolet", vetippok leh mishshum chashad umazzikin!
Bitre ucheshere.
"Mippene hammazzikin", vetippok leh mippene chashad umappolet!
Bechureba chadti, uvitre ucheshere.
I bitre, mazzikin name lekka!
Bimkoman chayyshinan. veibbaet ema: leolam bechad, uvechureba chadti dekae bedavra, dehatam mishshum chashad lekka deha ishsha bedavra la shechicha, umishshum mazzikin ikka.
Tanu rabbanan: arba mishmarot have hallayla, divre rabbi. rabbi natan omer: shalosh.
May tameh derabbi natan — dichtiv: "vayyavo gidon umea ish asher itto biktze hammachane rosh haashmoret hattichona", tana: en "tichona" ella sheyyesh lefaneha uleachareha.
Verabbi, may "tichona" — achat min hattichona shebbattichonot.
Verabbi natan mi ketiv "tichona shebbattichonot"? "tichona" ketiv!

May tameh derabbi? amar rabbi zerika, amar rabbi amme, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: katuv echad omer: "chatzot layla akum lehodot lach al mishpete tzidkecha", vechatuv echad omer: "kiddemu enay ashmurot" ha ketzad, arba mishmarot have hallayla.
Verabbi natan, savar la kerabbi yehoshua. ditnan, rabbi yehoshua omer: ad shalosh shaot, shekken derech melachim laamod beshalosh shaot. shet delelya, vetarte dimama, havu lehu shete mishmarot.
Rav ashe amar: mishmara ufalga name "mishmarot" karu lehu.
Veamar rabbi zerika, amar rabbi amme, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: en omrin bifne hammet ella devarav shel met.
Amar rabbi abba bar kahana: la amaran ella bedivre tora, aval mille dealma let lan ba.
Veikka deamri: amar rabbi abba bar kahana la amaran ella [afillu] bedivre tora vechol shekken mille dealma.
Vedavid befalga delelya hava kae? meureta hava kae! dichtiv: "kiddamti vanneshef vaashavvea", umimmay dehay "neshef" ureta hu? — dichtiv: "beneshef beerev yom beishon layla vaafela"!
Amar rav oshaya, amar rabbi acha: hachi kaamar (david): meolam lo avar alay chatzot layla beshena.
Rabbi zera amar: ad chatzot layla haya mitnamnem kesus, mikkan veelach haya mitgabber kaari. rav ashe amar: ad chatzot layla haya osek bedivre tora, mikkan veelach beshirot vetishbachot.
Veneshef" ureta hu? ha "neshef" tzafra hu! dichtiv: "vayyakkem david mehanneshef vead haerev lemochoratam". may lav — mitztzafra vead lelya?
La, meureta vead ureta.
I hachi, lichtov "mehanneshef vead hanneshef" o "mehaerev vead haerev"!
Ella amar rava: tere nishfe havu — neshaf lelya veate yemama, neshaf yemama veate lelya.
Vedavid mi hava yada palga delelya emat? hasheta moshe rabbenu la hava yada, dichtiv "kachatzot hallayla ani yotze betoch mitzrayim".

May "kachatzot". ilema daamar leh kudesha berich hu "kachatzot" — mi ikka sefeka kamme shemayya?! ella: daamar leh (limchar) "bachatzot" (ki hasheta), vaata ihu vaamar "kachatzot", alma: mesappeka leh, vedavid hava yada?!

David, simana hava leh, deamar rav acha bar bizna, amar rabbi shimon chasida: kinnor haya taluy lemala mimmittato shel david, vechevan shehiggia chatzot layla, ba ruach tzefonit venoshevet bo umenaggen meelav, miyyad haya omed veosek battora ad sheala ammud hashshachar. kevan sheala ammud hashshachar nichnesu chachme yisrael etzlo. amru lo: adonenu hammelech, ammecha yisrael tzerichin parnasa. amar lahem: lechu vehitparnesu ze mizze. amru lo: en hakkometz masbia et haari, veen habbor mitmalle mechuleyato. amar lahem: lechu ufishtu yedechem bigdud.
Miyyad yoatzim baachitofel, venimlachin besanhedrin, veshoalin beurim vetummim.
Amar rav yosef: may kera? dichtiv "veachare achitofel benayahu ben yehoyada veevyatar vesar tzava lammelech yoav".
Achitofel — ze yoetz, vechen hu omer: "vaatzat achitofel asher yaatz bayyamim hahem kaasher yishal ish bidvar haelohim".

a: "Benayahu ben yehoyada" ze sanhedrin, "veevyatar" ellu urim vetummim.

Vechen hu omer: "uvenayahu ben yehoyada al hakkereti veal happeleti". velamma nikra shemam "kereti" ufeleti"? "kereti" shekkortim divrehem, "peleti" shemmufelaim bedivrehem. veachar kach "sar tzava lammelech yoav".
Amar rav yitzchak bar adda, veamri la amar rav yitzchak bereh derav idi: may kera "ura chevodi ura hannevel vechinnor aira shachar".
Rabbi zera amar: moshe leolam hava yada, vedavid name hava yada.
Vechevan dedavid hava yada, kinnor lema leh? leitteore mishshinteh.

Vechevan demoshe hava yada, lema leh lememar "kachatzot"? — moshe kasavar: shemma yitu itztagnine paro, veyomru "moshe badday hu". deamar mar: lammed leshoncha lomar "eni yodea", shemma titbadde veteachez.
Rav ashe amar: befalga ureta ditlesar naghe arbesar hava kae, vehachi kaamar moshe leyisrael, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: lemachar kachatzot hallayla ki haiddana ani yotze betoch mitzrayim.

"Ledavid, shamra nafshi ki chasid ani". levi verabbi yitzchak. chad amar: kach amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, lo chasid ani? shekkol malche mizrach umaarav yeshenim ad shalosh shaot, vaani "chatzot layla akum lehodot lecha".

Veiddach, kach amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, lo chasid ani? shekkol malche mizrach umaarav yoshvim aguddot aguddot bichvodam, vaani yaday meluchelachot bedam uveshafir uveshilya kede letaher ishsha levaalah. velo od, ella kol ma sheani ose, ani nimlach bimfivoshet rabbi, veomer lo: "mefivoshet rabbi, yafe danti? yafe chiyyavti? yafe zikkiti? yafe tiharti? yafe timmeti?", velo boshti.
Amar rabbi yehoshua bereh derav idi: may kera — "vaadabbera veedotecha neged melachim velo evosh".
Tana: lo "mefivoshet" shemo, ella "ish bshet" shemo, velamma nikra shemo mefivoshet? shehaya mevayyesh pene david bahalacha, lefichach zacha david veyatza mimmennu kilav.
Veamar rabbi yochanan: lo "kilav" shemo ella "daniel" shemo, velamma nikra shemo "kilav" — shehaya machlim pene mefivoshet bahalacha.
Vealav amar shelomo bechachmato "beni im chacham libbecha yismach libbi gam ani", veomer: "chacham beni vesammach libbi veashiva chorfi davar".

Vedavid mi kare lenafsheh "chasid"? vehachtiv "lule heemanti lirot betuv Adonai beeretz chayyim", vetana mishshemeh derabbi yose: lamma nakud al "lule"? — amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, muvetach ani becha sheatta meshallem sachar tov latztzaddikim leatid lavo, aval eni yodea im yesh li chelek benehem im lav?!
Shemma yigrom hachet.
Kidrabbi yaakov bar idi, derabbi yaakov bar idi rame, ketiv: "vehinne anochi immach ushemarticha bechol asher telech", uchetiv: "vayyira yaakov meod" amar: shemma yigrom hachet.
Kidtanya "ad yaavor ammecha Adonai, ad yaavor am zu kanita".

"Ad yaavor ammecha Adonai" — zo bia rishona, "ad yaavor am zu kanita" — zo bia sheniyya. mikkan amru chachamim: reuyim hayu yisrael leasot lahem nes bime ezra kederech shennaasa lahem bime yehoshua bin nun. ella sheggaram hachet.
Vachachamim omrim ad chatzot: chachamim keman sevira lehu, i kerabbi eliezer sevira lehu — lemru kerabbi eliezer.
b: Vei kerabban gamliel sevira lehu — lemru kerabban gamliel.

Leolam kerabban gamliel sevira lehu, veha deka amri "ad chatzot", kede leharechik et haadam min haavera. kidtanya, chachamim asu seyayg ledivrehem, kede shello yehe adam ba min hassade baerev, veomer: "elech leveti veochal kima veeshte kima, veishan kima, veachar kach ekra keriat shema veetpallel", vechotafto shena venimtza yashen kol hallayla. aval adam ba min hassade baerev, nichnas levet hakkeneset, im ragil likrot — kore. veim ragil lishnot — shone, vekore keriat shema umitpallel, veochel pitto umevarech.
Vechol haover al divre chachamim chayyayv mita.
May shena bechol ducheta dela katane "chayyayv mita", umay shena hacha dekatane "chayyayv mita"?
Ibbaet ema mishshum deikka ones shena. veibbaet ema: leappoke mimman deamar "tefillat arvit reshut", ka mashma lan dechova.

Amar mar, kore keriat shema umitpallel. mesayyay leh lerabbi yochanan. deamar rabbi yochanan: ezehu ben haolam habba — ze hassomech geulla litfilla shel arvit. rabbi yehoshua ben levi omer: tefillot baemtza tikkenum.
Bemay ka mippallegi?
I baet ema kera, i baet ema sevara.
I baet ema sevara.
Derabbi yochanan savar geulla meureta name have, ella geulla meallayyta la havya ella ad tzafra. verabbi yehoshua ben levi savar kevan dela havya ella mitztzafra — la havya geulla meallayyta.
Veibbaet ema kera, ushenehem mikra echad darshu, dichtiv "beshachbecha uvekumecha".

Rabbi yochanan savar: makkish shechiva lekima, ma kima — keriat shema veachar kach tefilla, af shechiva name — keriat shema veachar kach tefilla. rabbi yehoshua ben levi savar: makkish shechiva lekima: ma kima — keriat shema samuch lemittato, af shechiva name — keriat shema samuch lemittato.
Metiv mar bereh deravina, baerev mevarech shetayim lefaneha ushetayim leachareha. vei amrat bae lismoch, ha la ka samech geulla litfilla, deha bae lememar "hashekivenu"!

Amri: kevan detakkinu rabbanan "hashekivenu" — kigulla arichta damya. dei la tema hachi, shacharit hechi matze samech? veha amar rabbi yochanan: battechilla omer: "Adonai sefatay tiftach", ulevassof hu omer: "yihyu leratzon imre fi".
Ella hatam kevan detakkinu rabbanan lememar "Adonai sefatay tiftach" — kitfilla arichta damya. hacha name, kevan detakkinu rabbanan lememar "hashekivenu" — kigulla arichta damya.
Amar rabbi elazar, amar rabbi avina: kol haomer "tehilla ledavid" bechol yom shalosh peamim — muvetach lo shehu ben haolam habba.
May tama?
Illema mishshum deatya bealef bet, nema "ashre temime darech" deatya bitmanya appin.
Ella mishshum deit beh "poteach et yadecha", nema "hallel haggadol" dichtiv beh "noten lechem lechol basar".
Ella mishshum deit beh tarte.
Amar rabbi yochanan: mippene ma lo neemar nun beashre" — mippene sheyyesh bah mappaltan shel sone yisrael, dichtiv: "nafla lo tosif kum betulat yisrael".

Bemareva metartzi la hachi: "nafla velo tosif linpol od, kum betulat yisrael". amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: afillu hachi, chazar david usemachan beruach hakkodesh, shenneemar "somech Adonai lechol hannoflim".

Amar rabbi elazar bar avina: gadol ma shenneemar bemichael yoter mimma shenneemar begavriel, deillu bemichael ketiv: "vayyaof elay echad min hasserafim". veillu gabbe gavriel ketiv: "vehaish gavriel asher raiti vechazon battechilla muaf biaf vegomer".
May mashma dehay "echad" michael hu?
Amar rabbi yochanan: atya "echad" "echad". ketiv hacha "vayyaof elay echad min hasserafim", uchetiv hatam: "vehinne michael echad (min) hassarim harishonim ba leazreni".
Tana: michael — beachat, gavriel — bishtayim, eliyyahu — bearba, umalach hammavet — bishmone. uvishat hammaggefa, beechat.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: af al pi shekkara adam keriat shema bevet hakkeneset — mitzva likroto al mittato. amar rabbi yose: may kera — "rigzu veal techetau imru vilvavchem al mishkavchem vedommu sela".
Amar rav nachman:

a: Im talmid chacham hu — en tzarich. amar abbaye: af talmid chacham mibbee leh lememar chad pesuka derachame, kegon: "beyadcha afkid ruchi, padita oti Adonai el emet".

Amar rabbi levi bar chama, amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: leolam yargiz adam yetzer tov al yetzer hara, shenneemar: "rigzu veal techetau" im nitztzecho — mutav, veim lav — yaasok battora, shenneemar: "imru vilvavchem". im nitztzecho — mutav, veim lav — yikra keriat shema, shenneemar: "al mishkavchem". im nitztzecho — mutav, veim lav — yizkor lo yom hammita, shenneemar: "vedommu sela".

Veamar rabbi levi bar chama, amar rabbi shimon ben lakish, may dichtiv "veettena lecha et luchot haeven vehattora vehammitzva asher katavti lehorotam". "luchot" — ellu aseret haddibberot, "tora" — ze mikra, "vehammitzva" — zo mishna, "asher katavti" — ellu neviim uchetuvim, "lehorotam" — ze talmud, melammed shekkullam nittenu lemoshe missinay.

Amar rabbi yitzchak: kol hakkore keriat shema al mittato, keillu ochez cherev shel shete fiyyot beyado. shenneemar: "rommot el bigronam vecherev pifiyyot beyadam", may mashma? amar mar zutera veittema rav ashe: meresha deinyana, dichtiv: "yalezu chasidim bechavod yerannenu al mishkevotam". uchetiv batreh: "rommot el bigronam vecherev pifiyyot beyadam".

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: kol hakkore keriat shema al mittato — mazzikin bedelin hemennu. shenneemar: "uvene reshef yagbihu uf", veen "uf" ella tora, shenneemar: "hataif enecha bo veenennu". veen "reshef" ella mazzikin, shenneemar: "meze raav ulechume reshef veketev meriri".

Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: kol haosek battora — yissurin bedelin hemennu, shenneemar: "uvene reshef yagbihu uf". veen "uf" ella tora, shenneemar "hataif enecha bo veenennu", veen "reshef" ella yissurin, shenneemar: "meze raav ulechume reshef".

Amar leh rabbi yochanan: ha afillu tinokot shel bet rabban, yodin oto, shenneemar "vayyomer im shamoa tishma lekol Adonai elohecha vehayyashar beenav taase vehaazanta lemitzvotav veshamarta kol chukkav kol hammachala asher samti vemitzrayim lo asim alecha ki ani Adonai rofecha". ella: kol sheefshar lo laasok battora veeno osek — hakkadosh baruch hu mevi alav yissurin mechoarin veochrin oto, shenneemar: "neelamti dumiyya hechesheti mittov ucheevi nekar", veen "tov" ella tora, shenneemar: "ki lekach tov natatti lachem torati al taazovu".

Amar rabbi zera veittema rabbi chanina bar pappa: bo uree shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam. middat basar vadam, adam mocher chefetz lachavero, mocher atzev, velokeach sameach, aval hakkadosh baruch hu eno ken, natan lahem tora leyisrael — vesamach, shenneemar: "ki lekach tov natatti lachem torati al taazovu".

Amar rava, veittema rav chisda: im roe adam sheyyissurin bain alav — yefashpesh bemaasav, shenneemar: "nachpesa derachenu venachkora venashuva ad Adonai". pishpesh velo matza — yitle bevittul tora, shenneemar: "ashre haggever asher teyasserennu yah umittoratcha telammedennu".
Veim tala velo matza — beyadua sheyyissurin shel ahava hem, shenneemar: "ki et asher yeehav Adonai yochiach".
Amar rava, amar rav sechora, amar rav huna: kol shehakkadosh baruch hu chafatz bo — medakkeo beyissurin, shenneemar: "vaAdonai chafetz dakkeo hecheli".
Yachol afillu lo kibbelam meahava? — talmud lomar: "im tasim asham nafsho", ma asham ledaat, af yissurin — ledaat.
Veim kibbelam ma secharo: "yire zera yaarich yamim". velo od ella shettalmudo mitkayyem beyado, shenneemar: "vechefetz Adonai beyado yitzlach".

Peligi ba rabbi yaakov bar idi verabbi acha bar chanina. chad amar: ellu hem yissurin shel ahava — kol sheen bahen bittul tora, shenneemar: "ashre haggever asher teyasserennu yah umittoratcha telammedennu".
Vechad amar: ellu hen yissurin shel ahava — kol sheen bahen bittul tefilla, shenneemar: "baruch elohim asher lo hesir tefillati vechasdo meitti".
Amar lehu rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba, hachi amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, amar rabbi yochanan: ellu vaellu yissurin shel ahava hen, shenneemar "ki et asher yeehav Adonai yochiach".
Ella ma talmud lomar "umittoratcha telammedennu" — al tikre "telammedennu", ella telammedenu. davar ze — mittoratcha telammedenu.
Kal vachomer mishshen vaayin. ma shen vaayin shehen echad meevarav shel adam — eved yotze bahen lecherut, yissurin shemmemarkin kol gufo shel adam — al achat kamma vechamma.

Vehayeynu derabbi shimon ben lakish, deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: neemar "berit" bemelach, veneemar "berit" beyissurin, neemar "berit" bemelach, dichtiv: "velo tashbit melach berit" veneemar "berit" beyissurin, dichtiv: "elle divre habberit", ma "berit" haamur bemelach — melach mematteket et habbasar, af "berit" haamur beyissurin — yissurin memarkin kol avonotav shel adam.
Tanya, rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: shalosh mattanot tovot natan hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael, vechullan lo netanan ella al yede yissurin, ellu hen: tora veeretz yisrael vehaolam habba.
Tora minnayin — shenneemar: "ashre haggever asher teyasserennu yah umittoratcha telammedennu".
Eretz yisrael, dichtiv: "ki kaasher yeyasser ish et beno Adonai elohecha meyasserekka", uchetiv batreh: "ki Adonai elohecha meviacha el eretz tova".
Haolam habba, dichtiv: "ki ner mitzva vetora or vederech chayyim tochchot musar".
Tane tanna kammeh derabbi yochanan: kol haosek betora uvigmilut chasadim
b: Vekover et banav — mochalin lo al kol avonotav.

Amar leh rabbi yochanan: bishlama tora ugemilut chasadim, dichtiv: "bechesed veemet yechuppar avon". "chesed" — zo gemilut chasadim, shenneemar: "rodef tzedaka vachased yimtza chayyim tzedaka vechavod". "emet" — zo tora, shenneemar: "emet kene veal timkor". ella "kover et banav" minnayin?
Tena leh hahu sava, mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: atya, "avon" "avon". ketiv hacha "bechesed veemet yechuppar avon", uchetiv hatam "umeshallem avon avot el chek benehem".
Amar rabbi yochanan: negaim uvanim — enan yissurin shel ahava.
Unegaim la? vehatanya: kol mi sheyyesh bo echad mearbaa marot negaim hallalu — enan ella mizbach kappara!
Mizbach kappara — havu, yissurin shel ahava — la havu.
Vei baet ema: ha — lan. veha — lehu.
Vei baet ema: ha — betzina, ha — befarhesya.
Uvanim la?! hechi dame, illema dahavo lehu umetu, veha amar rabbi yochanan, den garma daasiraa bir? ella ha — dela havo leh kelal. veha — dahavo leh umetu.
Rabbi chiyyay bar abba chalash. al legabbeh rabbi yochanan amar leh: chavivin alecha yissurin? amar leh: lo hen velo secharan. amar leh: hav li yedach. yehav leh yedeh, veokmeh.
Rabbi yochanan chalash. al legabbeh rabbi chanina. amar leh: chavivin alecha yissurin? amar leh: lo hen velo secharan. amar leh: hav li yedach. yehav leh yedeh, veokmeh.
Ammay, lokim rabbi yochanan lenafsheh?
Amri: en chavush mattir atzmo mibbet haasurim.

Rabbi elazar chalash. al legabbeh rabbi yochanan. chaza dahava ka gane bevet afel. galyeh lidraeh unefal nehora. chazyeh dahava ka bache rabbi elazar. amar leh: ammay ka bachet? i mishshum tora dela appesht — shaninu: echad hammarbe veechad hammamit, uvilvad sheyyechavven libbo lashshamayim. vei mishshum mezone — lo kol adam zoche lishte shulchanot. vei mishshum bene — den garma daasiraa bir.
Amar leh: lehay shufera devale beafra ka bachena. amar leh: al da vadday ka bachet, uvecho tarvayyhu.
Addehachi vehachi amar leh: chavivin alecha yissurin? amar leh: lo hen velo secharan. amar leh: hav li yedach, yehav leh yedeh, veokmeh.

Rav huna tekifu leh arba mea danne dechamra. al legabbeh rav yehuda achu derav salla chasida verabbanan, veamri la rav adda bar ahava verabbanan, vaamaru leh: leayyen mar bemileh. amar lehu: umi chashidna beenayychu? amaru leh: mi chashid kudesha berich hu deaved dina bela dina?!
Amar lehu: i ikka man dishmia alay milleta — lema. amaru leh: hachi shemia lan, dela yahev mar shevisha laariseh.
Amar lehu: mi ka shavek li midde minneh? ha ka ganev leh kulleh!

Amaru leh: hayeynu deamri inashe: "batar gannava genov, vetama teem". amar lehu: kabbelna alay deyahevna leh. ikka deamri: hadar challa vahava chamra. veikka deamri: iyyakkar challa, veizdevan bidme dechamra.

Tanya abba binyamin omer: al shene devarim hayiti mitztaer kol yamay — al tefillati shettehe lifne mittati, veal mittati shettehe netuna ben tzafon ledarom. "al tefillati shettehe lifne mittati", may "lifne mittati"? illema "lifne mittati" mammash, vehaamar rav yehuda, amar rav, veittema rabbi yehoshua ben levi: minnayin lammitpallel shello yehe davar chotzetz beno leven hakkir — shenneemar: "vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir vayyitpallel"? la tema, "lifne mittati", ella ema "samuch lemittati".
"Veal mittati shettehe netuna ben tzafon laddarom".
Deamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina, amar rabbi yitzchak: kol hannoten mittato ben tzafon ledarom havyin leh banim zecharim, shenneemar: "utzefunecha temalle vitnam yisbeu vanim".
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: af en ishto mappelet nefalim. ketiv hacha: "utzefunecha temalle bitnam", uchetiv hatam: "vayyimleu yameha laledet vehinne tomim bevitnah".

Tanya. abba binyamin omer: shenayim shennichnesu lehitpallel. vekadam echad mehem lehitpallel, velo himtin et chavero. veyatza. torfin lo tefillato befanav, shenneemar: "toref nafsho beappo halemaancha teazav aretz".
Velo od, ella sheggorem lashshechina shettistallek miyyisrael, shenneemar: "veyetak tzur mimkomo". veen "tzur" ella hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: tzur yeladcha teshi".
Veim himtin lo ma secharo?

a: Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: zoche labberachot hallalu, shenneemar: "lu hikshavta lemitzvotay vayhi channahar shelomecha vetzidkatcha kegalle hayyam. vayhi chachol zarecha vetzeetzae meecha" vegomer.
Tanya, abba binyamin omer: ilmale nittena reshut laayin lirot — en kol beriyya yechola laamod mippene hammazzikin.
Amar abbaye: inhu nefishi minnan, vekayymi alan ki kisla leugeya.
Amar rav huna: kol chad vechad minnan, alfa missemaleh urevavta miyyammineh.
Amar rava: hay ducheka dehave bechalla — minnayyhu have. hane birche deshalhi — minnayyhu. hane mane derabbanan devalu — mechufeya didhu. hane kare deminnakfan — minnayyhu.

Hay man devae lemidda lehu layyte kitma nehila, venahdar appureyeh, uvetzafra chaze ki kare detarnegola. hay man devae lemechezinhu, layte shilyeyta deshunnarta ukkamta bat ukkamta bucherta bat bucherta, velikleye benura, velishchakeh, velimle eneh minneh, vechaze lehu. velishdeyeh beguveta defarzela, velachtemeh begushepanka defarzela, dilma ganvi minneh, velachtom pummeh, ki hechi dela littazzak. rav bivi bar abbaye avad hachi, chaza veittazzak, beo rabbanan rachame aleh, veittassi.
Tanya, abba binyamin omer: en tefilla shel adam nishmaat ella bevet hakkeneset, shenneemar: "lishmoa el harinna veel hattefilla". bimkom rinna — sham tehe tefilla.
Amar ravin bar rav adda, amar rabbi yitzchak: minnayin shehakkadosh baruch hu matzuy bevet hakkeneset — shenneemar: "elohim nitztzav baadat el".
Uminnayin laasara shemmitpallelin sheshshechina immahem — shenneemar: "elohim nitztzav baadat el".
Uminnayin lishlosha sheyyoshvin baddin sheshshechina immahem, shenneemar: "bekerev elohim yishpot".
Uminnayin lishnayim sheyyoshvin veoskin battora sheshshechina immahem — shenneemar: "az nidberu yire Adonai ish el reehu vayyakshev Adonai" vegomer.
May "ulechoshve shemo"? amar rav ashe: chashav adam laasot mitzva, veneenas, velo asaah — maale alav hakkatuv keillu asaah.
Uminnayin sheafillu echad sheyyoshev veosek battora sheshshechina immo — shenneemar: "bechol hammakom asher azkir et shemi avo elecha uverachticha".
Vechi meachar daafillu chad, tere mibbaya?! tere — mikkatvan millayyhu besefer hazzichronot, chad — la mikkatvan milleh besefer hazzichronot.
Vechi meachar daafillu tere, telata mibbaya?! mahu detema: dina shelama bealma hu, vela atya shechina, kamashma lan dedina name hayeynu tora.
Vechi meachar daafillu telata, asara mibbaya?! asara — kadma shechina veatya. telata — ad deyatvi.
Amar rabbi avin bar rav adda, amar rabbi yitzchak: minnayin shehakkadosh baruch hu manniach tefillin shenneemar: "nishba Adonai bimino uvizroa uzzo".
"Bimino" — zo tora, shenneemar: "mimino esh dat lamo", "uvizroa uzzo" — ellu tefillin, shenneemar: "Adonai oz leammo yitten".
Uminnayin shehattefillin oz hem leyisrael — dichtiv: "verau kol amme haaretz ki shem Adonai nikra alecha veyaru mimmekka". vetanya, rabbi eliezer haggadol omer: ellu tefillin shebbarosh.
Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerav chiyyay bar avin: hane tefillin demare alma ma ketiv behu? amar leh "umi keammecha yisrael goy echad baaretz".

Umi mishtabbach kudesha berich hu beshivchayyhu deyisrael? in, dichtiv: "et Adonai heemarta hayyom". uchetiv: "vaAdonai heemircha hayyom", amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: attem asituni chativa achat baolam, vaani eese etchem chativa achat baolam.
Attem asituni chativa achat baolam, shenneemar: "shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad", vaani eese etchem chativa achat baolam", shenneemar "umi keammecha yisrael goy echad baaretz".
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: tinach bechad beta, bishar batte may?
Amar leh: "ki mi goy gadol", "umi goy gadol", "ashrecha yisrael", "o hanissa elohim", "uletittecha elyon".

I hachi, nefishi lehu tuve batte? ella: "ki mi goy gadol" "umi goy gadol" dedomyayn lahadade — bechad beta, "ashrecha yisrael" "umi keammecha yisrael" — bechad beta, "o hanissa elohim" — bechad beta, "uletittecha elyon" — bechad beta.
b: Vechullehu ketivi beedraeh.

Amar ravin bar rav adda, amar rabbi yitzchak: kol haragil lavo levet hakkeneset velo ba yom echad, hakkadosh baruch hu meshael bo, shenneemar: "mi vachem yere Adonai shomea bekol avdo asher halach chashechim veen noga lo".
Im lidvar mitzva halach — noga lo, veim lidvar harshut halach — en noga lo.
"Yivtach beshem Adonai" may tama? — mishshum dahava leh livtoach beshem Adonai, vela betach.
Amar rabbi yochanan: beshaa shehakkadosh baruch hu ba bevet hakkeneset, velo matza bah asara — miyyad hu koes, shenneemar: "maddua bati veen ish karati veen one".
Amar rabbi chelbo, amar rav huna: kol hakkovea makom litfillato — elohe avraham beezro.
Ucheshemmet, omrim lo: "e anav, e chasid, mittalmidav shel avraham avinu".
Veavraham avinu mena lan dikva makom? dichtiv: "vayyashkem avraham babboker el hammakom asher amad sham", veen "amida" ella tefilla, shenneemar: "vayyaamod pinchas vayfallel".
Amar rabbi chelbo, amar rav huna: hayyotze mibbet hakkeneset al yafsia pesia gassa. amar abbaye: la amaran, ella lemippak. aval lemeal — mitzva lemirhat, shenneemar: "nirdefa ladaat et Adonai".

Amar rabbi zera: meresh ki hava chazena lehu lerabbanan deka rahati lefirka beshabbeta, amena: "ka mechallayin rabbanan shabbeta". kevan dishmana leha derabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: leolam yarutz adam lidvar halacha vaafillu beshabbat, shenneemar: "achare Adonai yelchu kearye yishag" vegomer, ana name rahetna.
Amar rabbi zera: agra defirka — rihata.
Amar abbaye: agra dechalla — ducheka.
Amar rava: agra dishmata — sevara.
Amar rav pappa: agra deve tamya — shetikuta.
Amar mar zutera: agra detaanita — tzidketa.
Amar rav sheshet: agra dehespeda — dalloye.
Amar rav ashe: agra deve hillule — mille.
Amar rav huna: kol hammitpallel achore bet hakkeneset nikra "rasha", shenneemar: "saviv reshaim yithallachun".
Amar abbaye: la amaran ella dela mahdar appeh leve kenishta, aval mahdar appeh leve kenishta — let lan ba.
Hahu gavra deka metzalle achore be kenishta, vela mahdar appeh leve kenishta. chalaf eliyyahu. chazyeh, iddemi leh ketayyaya, amar leh: kedu var kayymat kamme marach?! shelaf safsera vekatleh.
Amar leh hahu merabbanan lerav bivi bar abbaye, veamri la rav bivi lerav nachman bar yitzchak: may "kerum zullut livne adam"?
Amar leh: ellu devarim sheomdim berumo shel olam, uvene adam mezalzelin bahen.
Rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvayyhu: kevan shennitztarech adam labberiyyot, panav mishtannot kichrum, shenneemar: "kerum zullut livne adam".
May "kerum"? ki ata rav dimi, amar: of echad yesh bichrakke hayyam, ucherum" shemo, vechevan shechamma zorachat mithappech lechamma gevonin.
Rabbi amme verabbi assi deamri tarvayyhu: keillu niddon bishne dinim, esh umayim, shenneemar: "hirkavta enosh leroshenu banu vaesh uvammayim".

Veamar rabbi chelbo, amar rav huna: leolam yehe adam zahir bitfillat hammincha, shehare eliyyahu lo naana ella bitfillat hammincha, shenneemar: "vayhi baalot hammincha vayyiggash eliyyahu hannavi vayyomar vegomer aneni Adonai aneni".
"Aneni" — shettered esh min hashshamayim, vaaneni" — shello yomru maase cheshafim hem.

Rabbi yochanan amar: af bitfillat arvit, shenneemar: "tikkon tefillati ketoret lefanecha masat kappay minchat arev". rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: af tefillat shacharit, shenneemar: "Adonai boker tishma koli, boker eeroch lecha vaatzappe".

Veamar rabbi chelbo, amar rav huna: kol hannehene misseudat chatan veeno mesammecho over bachamishsha kolot, shenneemar: "kol sason vekol simcha kol chatan vekol kalla kol omrim hodu et Adonai tzevaot".

Veim mesammecho ma secharo? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: zoche lattora shennittena bachamishsha kolot, shenneemar: "vayhi vayyom hashshelishi bihyot habboker vayhi kolot uverakim veanan kaved al hahar vekol shofar vegomer. vayhi kol hashshofar vegomer vehaelohim yaanennu vekol".
Inni? veha ketiv "vechol haam roim et hakkolot"!
Otan kolot, dekodem mattan tora havo.

Rabbi avahu amar: keillu hikriv toda, shenneemar: "meviim toda bet Adonai". rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: keillu bana achat mechurevot yerushalayim, shenneemar "ki ashiv et shevut haaretz kevarishona amar Adonai".
Veamar rabbi chelbo, amar rav huna: kol adam sheyyesh bo yirat shamayim — devarav nishmain, shenneemar: "sof davar hakkol nishma et haelohim yera vegomer".
May "ki ze kol haadam"? amar rabbi elazar, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: kol haolam kullo lo nivra ella bishvil ze.
Rabbi abba bar kahana amar: shakul ze keneged kol haolam kullo, rabbi shimon ben azzay omer, veamri la rabbi shimon ben zoma omer: kol haolam kullo lo nivra ella litzvot laze.

Veamar rabbi chelbo, amar rav huna: kol sheyyodea bachavero shehu ragil litten lo shalom, yakdim lo shalom, shenneemar: "bakkesh shalom verodfehu". veim natan lo velo hechezir — nikra "gazlan", shenneemar: "veattem biartem hakkerem gezelat heani bevattechem".

a: Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose: minnayin shehakkadosh baruch hu mitpallel? shenneemar: "vahaviotim el har kadshi vesimmachtim bevet tefillati", "tefillatam" lo neemar, ella "tefillati", mikkan shehakkadosh baruch hu mitpallel.
May metzalle?

Amar rav zutera bar toviyya, amar rav: "yehi ratzon millefanay sheyyichbeshu rachamay et kaasi, veyiggollu rachamay al middotay, veetnaheg im banay bemiddat rachamim, veekkanes lahem lifnim mishshurat haddin".

Tanya, amar rabbi yishmael ben elisha: paam achat, nichnasti lehaketir ketoret lifnay velifnim, veraiti achteriel yah Adonai tzevaot, shehu yoshev al kisse ram venissa, veamar li: "yishmael beni, barcheni!" amarti lo: "yehi ratzon millefanecha, sheyyichbeshu rachamecha et kaascha, veyiggollu rachamecha al middotecha, vetitnaheg im banecha bemiddat harachamim, vetikkanes lahem lifnim mishshurat haddin". venina li berosho. vekamashma lan, shello tehe birkat hedyot kalla beenecha.

Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose: minnayin sheen meratztzin lo leadam bishat kaso, dichtiv: "panay yelechu vahanichoti lach". amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: hameten li ad sheyyaavru panim shel zaam veaniach lecha.
Umi ikka ritcha kammeh dekudesha berich hu?
In, detanya "veel zoem bechol yom".

Vechamma zamo — rega. vechamma rega — echad mechameshet ribbo ushemonat alafim ushemone meot ushemonim ushemona beshaa, vezo hi rega. veen kol beriyya yechola lechavven otah shaa, chutz mibbilam harasha, dichtiv beh: "veyodea daat elyon".
Hasheta daat behemto lo hava yada, daat elyon hava yada?
Ella, melammed shehaya yodea lechavven otah shaa shehakkadosh baruch hu koes bah.
Vehayeynu deamar lehu navi leyisrael: "ammi zechar na ma yaatz balak melech moav vegomer". may "lemaan daat tzidkot Adonai"?
Amar rabbi elazar, amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: deu kamma tzedakot asiti immachem shello kaasti bime bilam harasha, sheilmale kaasti — lo nishtayyer missonehem shel yisrael sarid ufalit.
Vehayeynu dekaamar leh bilam levalak: "ma ekkov lo kabbo el uma ezom lo zaam Adonai", melammed shekkol otan hayyamim lo zaam.
Vechamma zamo — rega. vechamma rega? amar rabbi avin veittema rabbi avina: rega kememreh.
Umena lan derega ratach? — shenneemar: "ki rega beappo chayyim birtzono". vei baet ema mehacha: "chavi kimat rega ad yaavor zaam".
Veemat ratach? amar abbaye: behanach telat shae kammayayta ki chivvara karbalta detarnegola vekae achad kara.
Kol shata veshata name kae hachi?
Kol shata — it beh shureyayke summake, behahi shata let beh shureyayke summake.

Hahu mina dahava beshivvuteh derabbi yehoshua ben levi, hava ka metzaer leh tuva bikrae. yoma chad shekal tarnegola, veokmeh ben kareh dearsa, veayyen beh, sevar: ki mata hahi shata, elteyeh. ki meta hahi shata — nayem. amar: shema minna, lav orach ara lemebad hachi. "verachamav al kol maasav" ketiv.
Uchetiv: "gam anosh latztzaddik lo tov".
Tana, mishshemeh derabbi meir: beshaa shehachamma zorachat, vechol malche mizrach umaarav mannichim kitrehem berashehem umishtachavim lachamma, miyyad koes hakkadosh baruch hu.

Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose: tova mardut achat belibbo shel adam yoter mikkamma malkuyot. shenneemar: "veriddefa et meahaveha vegomer veamra elcha veashuva el ishi harishon ki tov li az meatta". veresh lakish amar, yoter mimmea malkuyot, shenneemar: "techat geara vemevin mehakkot kesil mea".

Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose: shelosha devarim bikkesh moshe millifne hakkadosh baruch hu, venatan lo. bikkesh shettishre shechina al yisrael, venatan lo, shenneemar: "halo belechtecha immanu".
Bikkesh shello tishre shechina al ovde kochavim, venatan lo, shenneemar: "veniflinu ani veammecha".

Bikkesh lehodio derachav shel hakkadosh baruch hu, venatan lo, shenneemar: "hodieni na et derachecha", amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam! mippene ma yesh tzaddik vetov lo, veyesh tzaddik vera lo, yesh rasha vetov lo, veyesh rasha vera lo? amar lo: moshe, tzaddik vetov lo — tzaddik ben tzaddik. tzaddik vera lo — tzaddik ben rasha. rasha vetov lo — rasha ben tzaddik. rasha vera lo — rasha ben rasha.
Amar mar: tzaddik vetov lo — tzaddik ben tzaddik, tzaddik vera lo — tzaddik ben rasha. inni? veha ketiv: "poked avon avot al banim", uchetiv: "uvanim lo yumetu al avot", veramenan kerae ahadade,
Umeshannenan: la kashya, ha — kesheochazin maase avotehem bidehem, ha — kesheen ochazin maase avotehem bidehem.
Ella, hachi kaamar leh: tzaddik vetov lo — tzaddik gamur, tzaddik vera lo — tzaddik sheeno gamur, rasha vetov lo — rasha sheeno gamur, rasha vera lo — rasha gamur.
Ufeliga derabbi meir, deamar rabbi meir: shetayim natnu lo veachat lo natnu lo, shenneemar: "vechannoti et asher achon" — af al pi sheeno hagun, "verichamti et asher arachem" — af al pi sheeno hagun.
"Vayyomer lo tuchal lirot et panay", tana mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben karcha, kach amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: kesheratziti — lo ratzita, achshav sheatta rotze — eni rotze.
Ufeliga derabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan, deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani, amar rabbi yonatan: bischar shalosh zacha leshalosh.
Bischar "vayyaster moshe panav" — zacha liklaster panim. bischar "ki yare" — zacha levayyiru miggeshet elav". bischar "mehabbit" — zacha leutemunat Adonai yabbit".
"Vahasiroti et kappi veraita et achoray". amar rav chana bar bizna, amar rabbi shimon chasida: melammed shehera hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe kesher shel tefillin.
Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose: kol dibbur vedibbur sheyyatza mippi hakkadosh baruch hu letova, afillu al tenay — lo chazar bo.

Mena lan — mimmoshe rabbenu, shenneemar "heref mimmenni veashmidem vegomer veeese otcha legoy atzum". af al gav diva moshe rachame ala demilleta uvattela, afillu hachi — okma bezareh. shenneemar: "bene moshe gershom veeliezer. vayyihyu vene eliezer rechavya harosh vegomer uvene rechavya ravu lemala vegomer".
Vetane rav yosef: "lemala" — mishshishshim ribbo, atya "reviyya" "reviyya". ketiv hacha: "ravu lemala", uchetiv hatam: "uvene yisrael paru vayyishretzu vayyirbu".
b: Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: miyyom shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu et haolam, lo haya adam shekkerao lehakkadosh baruch hu "adon", ad shebba avraham ukerao adon, shenneemar: "vayyomar adonay elohim bamma eda ki irashenna".

Amar rav: af daniel lo naana ella bishvil avraham, shenneemar: "veatta shema elohenu el tefillat avdecha veel tachanunav vehaer panecha al mikdashcha hashshamem lemaan adonay", "lemaancha" mibbee leh.
Ella — lemaan avraham shekkeraacha "adon".
Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: minnayin sheen meratztzin lo laadam bishat kaaso — shenneemar: "panay yelechu vahanichoti lach".

Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: miyyom shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu et olamo lo haya adam shehoda lehakkadosh baruch hu, ad shebbata lea vehodattu, shenneemar: "happaam ode et Adonai".

Reuven. amar rabbi elazar: amra lea: reu ma ben beni leven chami. deillu ben chami, af al gav demiddateh zabbenay livcheruteh, dichtiv: "vayyimkor et bechorato leyaakov", chazo ma ketiv beh: "vayyistom esav et yaakov".
Uchetiv: "vayyomer hachi kara shemo yaakov vayyakeveni ze faamayim" vegomer.

Veillu beni, af al gav deal kurcheh shakleh yosef livcheruteh minneh, dichtiv: "uvechallelo yetzue aviv nittena bechorato livne yosef", afillu hachi — la ikkanne beh, dichtiv: "vayyishma reuven vayyatztzilehu miyyadam".
Rut, may "rut"? amar rabbi yochanan: shezzachta veyatza mimmenna david sherivvahu lehakkadosh baruch hu beshirot vetishbachot.
Mena lan dishma garem? amar rabbi eliezer, deamar kera: "lechu chazu mifalot Adonai asher sam shammot baaretz", al tikre "shammot" ella "shemot".

Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: kasha tarbut raa betoch beto shel adam yoter mimmilchemet gog umagog. shenneemar: "mizmor ledavid bevarcho mippene avshalom beno", uchetiv batreh: "Adonai ma rabbu tzaray rabbim kamim alay", veillu gabbe milchemet gog umagog, ketiv: "lamma ragshu goyim uleummim yehgu rik". veillu "ma rabbu tzaray" la ketiv.
"Mizmor ledavid bevarcho mippene avshalom beno", "mizmor ledavid"?! "kina ledavid" mibbee leh!
Amar rabbi shimon ben avishalom: mashal lema haddavar dome? — leadam sheyyatza alav shetar chov. kodem shepperao haya atzev, leachar shepperao samach.

Af ken david, kevan sheamar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: "hinni mekim alecha raa mibbetecha", haya atzev, amar: shemma eved o mamzer hu, dela chayes alay. kevan dachaza deavshalom hu — samach. mishshum hachi amar "mizmor".
Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: muttar lehitgarot birshaim baolam hazze, shenneemar: "ozve tora yehallu rasha veshomre tora yitgaru vam".

Tanya name hachi, rabbi dostay berabbi matun omer: muttar lehitgarot birshaim baolam hazze, shenneemar: "ozve tora yehallu rasha" vegomer. veim lechashcha adam lomar: veha ketiv "al titchar bammereim al tekanne beose avla" — emor lo: mi shellibbo nokfo omer ken. ella: "al titchar bimreim" — lihyot kammereim, "al tekanne beose avla" — lihyot kaose avla.
Veomer: "al yekanne libbecha bachattaim ki im beyirat Adonai kol hayyom".

Ini?! vehaamar rabbi yitzchak: im raita rasha shehashshaa mesacheket lo al titgare bo, shenneemar: "yachilu derachav bechol et". velo od ella shezzoche baddin, shenneemar: "marom mishpatecha minnegdo". velo od ella sheroe betzarav, shenneemar: "kol tzorrav yafiach bahem"!
La kashya, ha bemille dideh, ha bemille dishmayya.
Veibbaet ema ha veha bemille dishmayya, vela kashya: ha berasha shehashshaa mesacheket lo, ha berasha sheen hashshaa mesacheket lo.

Veibbaet ema: ha veha, berasha shehashshaa mesacheket lo, vela kashya, ha, betzaddik gamur, ha, betzaddik sheeno gamur. deamar rav huna: may dichtiv, "lamma tabbit bogdim tacharish bevalla rasha tzaddik mimmennu", vechi rasha bolea tzaddik? veha ketiv: Adonai lo yaazvennu veyado, uchetiv: "lo yeunne latztzaddik kol aven". ella: tzaddik mimmennu — bolea, tzaddik gamur — eno bolea.
Veibbaet ema, shaa mesacheket lo — shane.

Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: kol hakkovea makom litfillato oyvav noflim tachtav. shenneemar: "vesamti makom leammi leyisrael unetativ veshachan tachtav velo yirgaz od velo yosifu vene avla leannoto kaasher barishona".
Rav huna rame ketiv "leannoto", uchetiv: "lechalloto".
Battechilla — leannoto, ulevassof — lechalloto.

Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: gedola shimmushah shel tora yoter millimmudah, shenneemar: "po elisha ben shafat asher yatzak mayim al yede eliyyahu". "lamad" lo neemar, ella "yatzak" — melammed sheggedola shimmushah yoter millimmudah.

Amar leh rabbi yitzchak lerav nachman: may tama la ate mar leve kenishta letzalloye? amar leh: la yachelna. amar leh: likkanfi lemar asra velitzalle. amar leh: tericha li milleta. velema leh mar lishlucha detzibbura, beiddana dimtzalle tzibbura lete velodeh lemar.
Amar leh may kulle hay? amar leh deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay:

a: May dichtiv "vaani tefillati lecha Adonai et ratzon". ematay et ratzon — beshaa shehatztzibbur mitpallelin.
Rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar mehacha: "ko amar Adonai beet ratzon aniticha".
Rabbi acha berabbi chanina amar mehacha: "hen el kabbir velo yimas": uchetiv: "pada veshalom nafshi mikkerav li ki verabbim hayu immadi".

Tanya name hachi, rabbi natan omer: minnayin sheen hakkadosh baruch hu moes bitfillatan shel rabbim shenneemar: "hen el kabbir velo yimas", uchetiv: "pada veshalom nafshi mikkerav li" vegomer, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: kol haosek betora uvigmilut chasadim umitpallel im hatztzibbur — maale ani alav keillu pedaani, li ulevanay, mibben ummot haolam.

Amar resh lakish: kol mi sheyyesh lo bet hakkeneset beiro, veeno nichnas sham lehitpallel, nikra "shachen ra", shenneemar: "ko amar Adonai al kol shechenay haraim hannogim bannachala asher hinchalti et ammi et yisrael". velo od ella sheggorem galut lo ulevanav, shenneemar: "hinni notsham meal admatam veet bet yehuda ettosh mittocham".

Amaru leh lerabbi yochanan: ikka save bevavel. tema vaamar: "lemaan yirbu yemechem vime venechem al haadama" ketiv, aval bechutza laaretz — la? kevan deamri leh mekaddemi umechashshechi leve chenishta, amar: hayeynu deahani lehu.

Deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi livneh: kaddimu vechashshichu veayyilu leve chenishta, ki hechi detorchu chayye. amar rabbi acha berabbi chanina: may kera — "ashre adam shomea li lishkod al daltotay yom yom lishmor mezuzot petachay", uchetiv batreh: "ki motzi matza chayyim".
Amar rav chisda: leolam yikkanes adam shene fetachim bevet hakkeneset. shene fetachim salka datach?! ella ema, shiur shene fetachim, veachar kach yitpallel.
"Al zot yitpallel kol chasid elecha leet metzo", amar rabbi chanina: "leet metzo" zo ishsha, shenneemar: "matza ishsha matza tov".
Bemareva ki nasev inash itteta, amri leh hachi: "matza" o "motze"? "matza" dichtiv: "matza ishsha matza tov vayyafek ratzon meAdonai", "motze" dichtiv: "umotze ani mar mimmavet et haishsha" vegomer.
Rabbi natan omer: "leet metzo" — zo tora, shenneemar: "ki motzi matza chayyim" vegomer.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar — "leet metzo" zo mita, shenneemar: "lammavet totzaot".

Tanya name hachi: tesha meot ushelosha mine mita nivreu baolam, shenneemar: "lammavet totzaot", "totzaot" begimatriyya hachi havu. kasha shebbechullan — askara, nicha shebbechullan — neshika. askara damya kechizra bigvava deamra dilachore nashra, veikka deamri kefitture befi veshet, neshika damya kemishchal binita mechalava.

Rabbi yochanan amar: "leet metzo" — zo kevura. amar rabbi chanina, may kera "hassemechim ele gil yasisu ki yimtzeu kaver". amar rabba bar rav shela, hayeynu deamri inashe: live inash rachame afillu ad zibbula batrayyta shelama.
Mar zutera amar: "leet metzo" — ze bet hakkisse. amri bemareva: ha demar zutera adifa mikkullehu.
Amar leh rava lerafram bar pappa: lema lan mar mehane mille mealleyayta deamrat mishshemeh derav chisda bemille deve chenishta.
Amar leh, hachi amar rav chisda: may dichtiv, "ohev Adonai shaare tziyyon mikkol mishkenot yaakov": ohev Adonai shearim hametzuyyaynim bahalacha, yoter mibbatte chenesiyyot umibbatte midrashot.
Vehayeynu deamar rabbi chiyyay bar amme mishshemeh deulla: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash en lo lehakkadosh baruch hu beolamo ella arba ammot shel halacha bilvad.

Veamar abbaye: meresh hava garesna bego beta umetzallena beve chenishta. kevan dishmana leha deamar rabbi chiyyay bar amme mishshemeh deulla — miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash en lo lehakkadosh baruch hu beolamo ella arba ammot shel halacha bilvad — la hava metzallena ella hecha degaresna.
Rabbi amme verabbi assi af al gav dahavo lehu telesar be chenishta bitverya la metzallu ella bene ammude, hecha dahavo garsi.

Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar amme mishshemeh deulla: gadol hannehene migio yoter miyyere shamayim, deillu gabbe yere shamayim ketiv "ashre ish yare et Adonai", veillu gabbe nehena migio ketiv: "yegia kappecha ki tochel ashrecha vetov lach". "ashrecha" — baolam hazze, "vetov lach" — laolam habba, ulegabbe yere shamayim, "vetov lach" la ketiv beh.
Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar amme mishshemeh deulla: leolam yadur adam bimkom rabbo, shekkol zeman sheshshimi ben gera kayyaym, lo nasa shelomo et bat paro.
Vehatanya al yadur!
La kashya, ha dichyif leh, ha dela keyif leh.
Amar rav huna bar yehuda, amar rabbi menachem, amar rabbi amme: may dichtiv, "veozve Adonai yichlu" — ze hammanniach sefer tora veyotze.
Rabbi avahu nafek ben gavra legavra.
Bae rav pappa: ben pesuka lifsuka mahu?
Teku.
Rav sheshet mahdar appeh vegares. amar: anan bedidan veinhu bedidhu.
Amar rav huna bar yehuda, amar rabbi amme: leolam yashlim adam parashiyyotav im hatztzibbur. shenayim mikra veechad targum.
b: Vaafillu "atarot vedivon". shekkol hammashlim parashiyyotav im hatztzibbur mearichin lo yamav ushenotav.
Rav bivi bar abbaye savar leashlominhu lefarashyayta decholla shatta bemaale yoma dechippure, tena leh chiyyay bar rav middifti: ketiv: "veinnitem et nafshotechem betisha lachodesh baerev".
Vechi betisha mitannin?! vahalo baasara mitannin! ella lomar lecha kol haochel veshote bitshii, maale alav hakkatuv keillu mitanne teshii vaasiri.
Savar leakdominhu, amar leh hahu sava, tenena: uvilvad shello yakdim veshello yeacher.
Kedaamar lehu rabbi yehoshua ben levi livneh: ashlimu parashyotayychu im hatztzibbur shenayim mikra veechad targum.
Vehizzaharu bivridin kerabbi yehuda, ditnan: rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyishchot et havveridin.
Vehizzaharu bezaken sheshshachach talmudo mechamat onso. deamrinan: luchot veshivre luchot munnachot baaron.
Amar lehu rava livneh: kesheattem chotchin basar, al tachtechu al gav hayyad. ikka deamri: mishshum sakkana. veikka deamri: mishshum kilkul seuda.

Veal teshvu al mittat arammit, veal taavru achore bet hakkeneset beshaa shehatztzibbur mitpallelin. veal teshvu al mittat arammit, ikka deamri la tigno bela keriat shema, veikka deamri dela tinsevu giyyorta. veikka deamri, arammit mammash.

Umishshum maase derav pappa. derav pappa azal legabbe arammit, hotzia lo mitta. amra lo: shev! amar lah: eni yoshev, ad shettagbihi et hammitta. higbiha et hammitta umatzu sham tinok met. mikkan amru chachamim: asur leshev al mittat arammit.

Veal taavru achore bet hakkeneset beshaa shehatztzibbur mitpallelin — mesayyay leh lerabbi yehoshua ben levi. deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: asur lo leadam sheyyaavor achore bet hakkeneset beshaa shehatztzibbur mitpallelin.

Amar abbaye: vela amaran ella delekka pitcha acharina, aval ikka pitcha acharina — let lan ba. vela amaran ella delekka be chenishta acharina, aval ikka be chenishta acharina — let lan ba. vela amaran ella dela dare tuna, vela rahet, vela mannach tefillin, aval ikka chad mehanach — let lan ba.

Tanya, amar rabbi akiva: bishlosha devarim ohev ani et hammadiyyim, keshechotchin et habbasar — en chotchin ella al gabbe hashshulechan, keshennoshkin — en noshkin ella al gav hayyad, uchesheyyoatzin — en yoatzin ella bassade.
Amar rav adda bar ahava: may keraa "vayyishlach yaakov vayyikra lerachel ulelea hassade el tzono".
Tanya amar rabban gamliel: bishlosha devarim ohev ani et happarsiyyim: hen tzenuin baachilatan, utzenuin bevet hakkisse, utzenuin bedavar acher.
"Ani tzivveti limkuddashay", tane rav yosef: ellu happarsiyyim hamekuddashin umezummanin legehinnam.
Rabban gamliel omer vechulei: amar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: halacha kerabban gamliel.

Tanya: rabbi shimon ben yochay omer peamim sheadam kore keriat shema shete peamim ballayla, achat kodem sheyyaale ammud hashshachar veachat leachar sheyyaale ammud hashshachar, veyotze bahen yede chovato achat shel yom veachat shel layla.

Ha gufa kashya, amrat: peamim sheadam kore keriat shema shete peamim ballayla, alma leachar sheyyaale ammud hashshachar lelya hu, vahadar tane: yotze bahen yede chovato achat shel yom veachat shel layla, alma yemama hu!
La — leolam lelya hu. veha dekare leh "yom" — deikka inashe dekayymi behahi shata.
Amar rav acha bar chanina, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: halacha kerabbi shimon ben yochay.

Ikka dematne leha derav acha bar chanina aha. detanya, rabbi shimon ben yochay omer mishshum rabbi akiva: peamim sheadam kore keriat shema shete peamim bayyom, achat kodem hanetz hachamma, veachat leachar hannetz hachamma, veyotze bahen yede chovato, achat shel yom veachat shel layla.

Ha gufa kashya. amrat peamim sheadam kore keriat shema shete peamim bayyom, alma kodem hanetz hachamma yemama hu, vahadar tane yotze bahen yede chovato achat shel yom veachat shel layla, alma lelya hu!

a: La, leolam yemama hu, vehay dekaru leh "lelya" — deikka inashe deganu behahi shata.
Amar rabbi acha berabbi chanina, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: halacha kerabbi shimon sheamar mishshum rabbi akiva. amar rabbi zera: uvilvad shello yomar "hashekivenu".
Ki ata rav yitzchak bar yosef, amar: ha derabbi acha berabbi chanina amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, lav beferush ittemar, ella mikkelala ittemar.
Dehahu zuga derabbanan deishtakkur behillula divreh derabbi yehoshua ben levi. ato lekammeh derabbi yehoshua ben levi, amar: keday hu rabbi shimon lismoch alav bishat haddechak.
Maase shebbau banav vechulei:
Vead hasheta la shemia lehu ha derabban gamliel?!

Hachi kaamri leh: rabbanan peligi illavoch, veyachid verabbim, halacha kerabbim, o dilma rabbanan kevotach sevira lehu, vehay dekaamri "ad chatzot" — kede leharechik adam min haavera. amar lehu: rabbanan kevoti sevira lehu, vechayyayvin attem. vehay dekaamri "ad chatzot" — kede leharechik adam min haavera.
Velo zo bilvad amru, ella vechulei:
Verabban gamliel mi kaamar "ad chatzot" dekatane "velo zo bilvad amru"?
Hachi kaamar lehu rabban gamliel livneh: afillu lerabbanan dekaamri "ad chatzot", mitzvatah ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. vehay deka amri ad chatzot — kede leharechik adam min haavera.
Hekter chalavim vechulei.
Veillu achilat pesachim la katane.
Ureminhi: keriat shema arvit, vehallel belele pesachim, vaachilat pesach, mitzvatan ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar!

Amar rav yosef: la kashya: ha rabbi elazar ben azarya, ha rabbi akiva. detanya: "veachlu et habbasar ballayla hazze", rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: neemar kan "ballayla hazze", veneemar lehallan: "veavarti veeretz mitzrayim ballayla hazze", ma lehallan ad chatzot, af kan ad chatzot.
Amar leh rabbi akiva: vahalo kevar neemar "bechippazon", ad sheat chippazon. im ken ma talmud lomar "ballayla"?
Yachol yehe neechol kekadashim bayyom talmud lomar "ballayla", ballayla hu neechol, velo bayyom.
Bishlama lerabbi elazar ben azarya deit leh gezera shava, itzterich lemichtav leh "hazze". ella lerabbi akiva hay "hazze" may aved leh?

Lemaote layla acher hu daata, salka datach amena: hoil ufesach kadashim kallim, ushelamim kadashim kallim, ma shelamim neechalin lishne yamim velayla echad — af pesach neechol shete lelot bimkom shene yamim, vihe neechol lishne lelot veyom echad. kamashma lan "ballayla hazze", ballayla hazze hu neechol veeno neechol belayla acher.
Verabbi elazar ben azarya
Millo totiru ad boker" nafka.
Verabbi akiva — i mehatam, hava amena may "boker" — boker sheni.
Verabbi elazar amar lach: kol "boker" — boker rishon hu.
Vehane tannae kehane tannae. detanya, "sham tizbach et happesach baarev kevo hashshemesh moed tzetcha mimmitzrayim".

Rabbi eliezer omer: "baerev" atta zoveach, uchevo hashshemesh" atta ochel, umoed tzetcha mimmitzrayim" atta soref. rabbi yehoshua omer "baerev" atta zoveach "kevo hashshemesh" atta ochel vead matay atta ochel veholech — ad "moed tzetcha mimmitzrayim".

Amar rabbi abba: hakkol modim keshennigalu yisrael mimmitzrayim, lo nigalu ella baerev, shenneemar: "hotziacha Adonai elohecha mimmitzrayim layla", uchesheyyatzu — lo yatzu ella bayyom, shenneemar: "mimmochorat happesach yatzu vene yisrael beyad rama".
Al ma nechleku — al sheat chippazon, rabbi elazar ben azarya savar: may "chippazon" — chippazon demitzrayim.
Verabbi akiva savar: may "chippazon" — chippazon deyisrael.

Tanya name hachi: "hotziacha Adonai elohecha mimmitzrayim layla": vechi ballayla yatzu? vahalo lo yatzu ella bayyom, shenneemar: "mimmochorat happesach yatzu vene yisrael beyad rama"! ella, melammed shehitchila lahem geulla mibbaerev.

"Dabber na beazne haam" vegomer. amri deve rabbi yannay: en "na" ella leshon bakkasha, amar leh hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: bevakkasha mimmecha, lech veemor lahem leyisrael: bevakkasha mikkem, shaalu mimmitzrayim kele chesef uchele zahav, shello yomar
b: Oto tzaddik, "vaavadum veinnu otam" — kiyyem bahem, "veachare chen yetzu birchush gadol" — lo kiyyem bahem.

Amru lo: ulevay shennetze beatzmenu! mashal: leadam shehaya chavush bevet haasurim vehayu omrim lo bene adam: motziin otcha lemachar mibbet haasurin, venotnin lecha mamon harebe, veomer lahem: bevakkasha mikkem, hotziuni hayyom, veeni mevakkesh kelum.
"Vayyashilum", amar rabbi amme: melammed shehishilum beal karcham. ikka deamri beal karcham demitzrayim, veikka deamri beal karcham deyisrael.
Man deamar beal karcham demitzrayim — dichtiv: "unevat bayit techallek shalal". man deamar beal karcham deyisrael — mishshum massoy.
"Vaynatztzelu et mitzrayim". amar rabbi amme melammed sheasauha kimtzuda sheen bah dagan, veresh lakish amar, asauha kimtzula sheen bah dagim.
"Ehye asher ehye", amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe, lech emor lahem leyisrael: ani hayiti immachem beshibud ze, vaani ehye immachem beshibud malchuyot.
Amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, dayya latztzara bishatah. amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: lech emor lahem "ehye shelachani alechem".

"Aneni Adonai aneni". amar rabbi avahu: lama amar eliyyahu aneni shete peamim? melammed sheamar eliyyahu lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, "aneni" — shettered esh min hashshamayim vetochal kol asher al hammizbeach, vaaneni" — shettassiach datam, kede shello yomru maase cheshafim hem. shenneemar: "veatta hasibbota et libbam achorannit":

Mishna meematay korin et shema beshacharit? mishsheyyakkir ben techelet lelavan. rabbi eliezer omer: ben techelet lecharate. vegomrah, ad hanetz hachamma, rabbi yehoshua omer ad shalosh shaot, shekken derech melachim laamod beshalosh shaot.
Hakkore mikkan veelach — lo hifsid, keadam hakkore battora.
Gemara may ben techelet lelavan? illema ben gevava deamra chivvara ligvava deamra ditchelta — ha belelya name midda yadi. ella, ben techelet shebbah lelavan shebbah.
Tanya: rabbi meir omer: mishsheyyakkir ben zeev lechelev. rabbi akiva omer: ben chamor learod. vaacherim omrim: mishsheyyire et chavero rachok arba ammot, veyakkirennu.
Amar rav huna: halacha kaacherim. amar abbaye: litfillin kaacherim. likriat shema kevatikin. deamar rabbi yochanan vatikin hayu gomrin otah im hanetz hachamma.
Tanya name hachi: vatikin hayu gomrin otah im hanetz hachamma, kede sheyyismoch geulla litfilla, venimtza mitpallel bayyom.
Amar rabbi zera: may keraa — "yiraucha im shamesh velifne yareach dor dorim".
Heid rabbi yose ben elyakim mishshum kehala kaddisha devirushalayim: kol hassomech geulla litfilla eno nizzok kol hayyom kullo.

Amar rabbi zera: ini?! veha ana semachi veittezaki! amar leh: bemay ittezakt — deamteyit asa leve malka. hatam name mibbee lach lemehav agra lemichze appe malka, deamar rabbi yochanan: leolam yishtaddel adam larutz likrat malche yisrael. velo likrat malche yisrael bilvad, ella afillu likrat malche ummot haolam, sheim yizke — yavchin ben malche yisrael lemalche ummot haolam!

Amar leh rabbi illaa leulla: ki ayylat lehatam sheel bishlama derav berona achi bemaamad kol hachavura, deadam gadol hu vesameach bemitzvot. zimna chada semach geulla litfilla vela pesek chucha mippummeh kulleh yoma.
Hechi matze samech? veha amar rabbi yochanan: battechilla hu omer: "Adonai sefatay tiftach", ulevassof hu omer: "yihyu leratzon imre fi vegomer"!
Amar rabbi elazar: tehe bitfilla shel arvit.
Veha amar rabbi yochanan: ezehu ben haolam habba — zehu hassomech geulla shel arvit litfilla shel arvit!
Ella amar rabbi elazar: tehe bitfillat hammincha.
Rav ashe amar: afillu tema akkullehu, vechevan dekavuha rabbanan bitfilla — kitfilla arichta damya.

Dei la tema hachi, arvit hechi matze samech, veha bae lememar "hashekivenu"! ella kevan detakkinu rabbanan hashekivenu — kigulla arichta damya. hachi name kevan dekavuha rabbanan bitfilla — kitfilla arichta damya.
Mikkede, hay "yihyu leratzon imre fi" mashma livsof, umashma meikkara devaena lememar. may tama takkenuhu rabbanan leachar shemone esre berachot? lemru meikkara!
Amar rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi: hoil velo amaro david ella leachar shemone esre parashiyyot, lefichach takkinu rabbanan leachar shemone esre berachot.
Hane shemone esre?! tesha esre havyan!
"Ashre haish" velamma ragshu goyim" chada parasha hi.

Deamar rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi: mea veshalosh parashiyyot amar david, velo amar "haleluyah" ad sheraa bemappaltan shel reshaim, shenneemar: "yittammu chattaim min haaretz ureshaim od enam, barchi nafshi et Adonai haleluyah".
Hane mea veshalosh? mea vearba havyayn! ella shema minna "ashre haish" velamma ragshu goyim" chada parasha hi.
Deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan:

a: Kol parasha shehayta chaviva al david, patach bah beashre" vesiyyem bah beashre". patach beashre", dichtiv: "ashre haish". vesiyyem beashre", dichtiv: "ashre kol chose vo".

Hanhu biryone dahavo beshivavuteh derabbi meir vahavo ka metzaaru leh tuva. hava ka bae rabbi meir rachame illavayhu ki hechi delemutu. amra leh berureya devethu: may datach — mishshum dichtiv "yittammu chattaim", mi ketiv "chotim"? "chattaim" ketiv.
Veod, shefel lesefeh dikra "ureshaim od enam", kevan deyittammu chattaim" "ureshaim od enam"? ella bei rachame illavayhu delahderu bitshuva, "ureshaim od enam".
Bea rachame illavayhu, vahadaru bitshuva.
Amar la hahu mina livrureya: ketiv "ranni akara lo yalada", mishshum delo yalada — ranni?
Amara leh: shatya, shefel lesefeh dikra, dichtiv: "ki rabbim bene shomema mibbene veula amar Adonai".
Ella may "akara lo yalada" — ranni keneset yisrael sheddoma leishsha akara shello yalda banim legehinnam kevatayychu.

Amar leh hahu mina lerabbi avahu, ketiv: "mizmor ledavid bevarcho mippene avshalom beno", uchetiv: "ledavid michtam bevarcho mippene shaul bammeara". he maase hava beresha? mikkedi maase shaul hava beresha, lichtov beresha.
Amar leh: attun dela darshitun semuchin — kashya lechu, anan dedarshinan semuchim — la kashya lan.
Deamar rabbi yochanan: semuchin min hattora minnayin — shenneemar: "semuchim laad leolam asuyim beemet veyashar".
Lamma nismecha parashat avshalom lefarashat gog umagog — sheim yomar lecha adam: kelum yesh eved shemmored berabbo?! af atta emor lo: kelum yesh ben shemmored beaviv? ella hava, hacha name hava.

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay. may dichtiv, "piha patcha vechachma vetorat chesed al leshonah". keneged mi amar shelomo mikra ze? — lo amaro ella keneged david aviv, sheddar bachamishsha olamim, veamar shira.
Dar bime immo veamar shira, shenneemar: "barchi nafshi et Adonai vechol keravay et shem kadsho".
Yatza laavir haolam venistakkel bechochavim umazzalot veamar shira, shenneemar: "barchu Adonai malachav gibbore choach ose devaro lishmoa bekol devaro barchu Adonai kol tzevaav vegomer".
Yanak mishshede immo venistakkel bedaddeha veamar shira, shenneemar: "barchi nafshi et Adonai veal tishkechi kol gemulav".
May "kol gemulav". amar rabbi avahu: sheasa lah daddim bimkom bina.
Tama may? amar rav yehuda: kede shello yistakkel bimkom erva. rav matna amar: kede shello yinak mimmekom hattinnofet.
Raa bemappaltan shel reshaim, veamar shira, shenneemar: "yittammu chattaim min haaretz ureshaim od enam barchi nafshi et Adonai haleluyah".
Nistakkel beyom hammita, veamar shira, shenneemar: "barchi nafshi et Adonai, Adonai elohay gadalta meod hod vehadar lavashta".
May mashma deal yom hammita neemar? amar rabba bar rav shela, missefa deinyayna, dichtiv: "tastir panecha yibbahelun tosef rucham yigvaun vegomer".

Rav shimi bar ukeva veamri la mar ukeva, hava shechiach kammeh derabbi shimon ben pazzi, vahava mesaddar aggadata kammeh derabbi yehoshua ben levi. amar leh: may dichtiv, "barchi nafshi et Adonai vechol keravay et shem kadsho"? amar leh: bo uree shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam. middat basar vadam tzar tzura al gabbe hakkotel, veeno yachol lehatil bah ruach uneshama keravayim uvene meayim. vehakkadosh baruch hu eno ken, tzar tzura betoch tzura umetil bah ruach uneshama keravayim uvene meayim. vehayeynu deamra channa: "en kadosh chaAdonai ki en biltecha veen tzur kelohenu".
May "en tzur kelohenu" — en tzayyayr kelohenu.

May "ki en biltecha"? amar rabbi yehuda bar menasya: al tikre "ki en biltecha", ella "en levallotecha". shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam: middat basar vadam — maase yadav mevallin oto, vehakkadosh baruch hu mevalle maasav.
Amar leh, ana hachi ka amena lach: hane chamishsha "barchi nafshi" keneged mi amaran david? lo amaran ella keneged hakkadosh baruch hu ucheneged neshama.

Ma hakkadosh baruch hu male kol haolam — af neshama melea et kol hagguf. ma hakkadosh baruch hu roe veeno nire — af neshama roa veenah niret. ma hakkadosh baruch hu zan et kol haolam kullo — af neshama zana et kol hagguf. ma hakkadosh baruch hu tahor — af neshama tehora. ma hakkadosh baruch hu yoshev bechadre chadarim — af neshama yoshevet bechadre chadarim. yavo mi sheyyesh bo chamishsha devarim hallalu vishabbeach lemi sheyyesh bo chamishsha devarim hallalu.

Amar rav hamenuna: may dichtiv "mi kehechacham umi yodea pesher davar" — mi kehakkadosh baruch hu sheyyodea laasot peshara ben shene tzaddikim, ben chizkiyyahu lishayahu. chizkiyyahu amar: lete yeshayahu gabbay, dehachi ashkechan beeliyyahu daazal legabbe achav, shenneemar: "vayyelech eliyyahu leheraot el achav". yeshayahu amar: lete chizkiyyahu gabbay dehachi ashkechan bihoram ben achav daazal legabbe elisha.

Ma asa hakkadosh baruch hu — hevi yissurim al chizkiyyahu, veamar lo lishayahu: lech uvakker et hachole. shenneemar: "bayyamim hahem chala chizkiyyahu lamut vayyavo elav yeshayahu ben amotz hannavi vayyomer elav ko amar Adonai tzevaot tzav levetecha ki met atta velo tichye vegomer". may "ki met atta velo tichye": met atta — baolam hazze, velo tichye — laolam habba.
Amar leh: may kulle hay? amar leh: mishshum dela asakt bifriyya ureviyya. amar leh: mishshum dachazay li beruach hakkodesh denafki minnay benin dela meallu.
Amar leh: bahade kavshe derachamana lema lach? may demippakkedat ibbei lach lemebad, uma denicha kammeh kudesha berich hu — laaved.
Amar leh: hasheta hav li berattach, efshar degarma zechuta didi vedidach, venafki minnay benin dimallu. amar leh: kevar nigzera alecha gezera. amar leh: ben amotz, kalle nevuatcha vatze!
Kach mekkubbelani mibbet avi abba, afillu cherev chadda munnachat al tzavvaro shel adam, al yimna atzmo min harachamim.
Ittemar name, rabbi yochanan verabbi eliezer deamri tarvayyhu: afillu cherev chadda munnachat al tzavvaro shel adam, al yimna atzmo min harachamim. shenneemar: "hen yikteleni lo ayachel".
b: Amar rabbi chanan: afillu baal hachalomot omer lo leadam lemachar hu met — al yimna atzmo min harachamim. shenneemar: "ki verov chalomot vahavalim udevarim harebe ki et haelohim yera".
Miyyad "vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir vayyitpallel el Adonai".
May "kir"? amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: mikkirot libbo, shenneemar: "meay meay ochila kirot libbi vegomer".

Rabbi levi amar: al iske hakkir, amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, uma shunammit shello asta ella kir achat ketanna hecheyeta et benah, avi abba shechippa et hahechol kullo bechesef uvezahav al achat kamma vechamma. "zechar na et asher hithallachti lefanecha beemet uvelev shalem vehattov beenecha asiti".
May "vehattov beenecha asiti"? amar rav yehuda amar rav: shessamach geulla litfilla. rabbi levi amar: shegganaz sefer refuot.
Tanu rabbanan: shishsha devarim asa chizkiyyahu hammelech, al shelosha hodu lo, veal shelosha lo hodu lo.
Al shelosha hodu lo: ganaz sefer refuot — vehodu lo. kittet nechash hannechoshet — vehodu lo. gerar atzmot aviv al mitta shel chavalim — vehodu lo.
Veal shelosha lo hodu lo: satam me gichon — velo hodu lo. kitztzetz daltot hechol veshiggeram lemelech ashshur — velo hodu lo. ibber nisan benisan — velo hodu lo.
Umi let leh lechizkiyyahu, "hachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim": ze nisan veen acher nisan?!
Ella, tea bedishmuel deamar shemuel, en meabberin et hashshana beyom sheloshim shel adar, hoil verauy lekovo nisan. savar: "hoil verauy" — la amrinan.
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose ben zimra: kol hattole bizchut atzmo — tolin lo bizchut acherim. vechol hattole bizchut acherim — tolin lo bizchut atzmo.

Moshe tala bizchut acherim, shenneemar: "zechor leavraham leyitzchak uleyisrael avadecha". talu lo bizchut atzmo, shenneemar: "vayyomer lehashemidam lule moshe vechiro amad bapperetz lefanav lehashiv chamato mehashechit".

Chizkiyyahu tala bizchut atzmo, dichtiv: "zechar na et asher hithallachti lefanecha", talu lo bizchut acherim, shenneemar: "vegannoti el hair hazzot lehoshiah lemaani ulemaan david avdi". vehayeynu derabbi yehoshua ben levi. deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: may dichtiv "hinne leshalom mar li mar" — afillu beshaa sheshshigger lo hakkadosh baruch hu shalom, mar hu lo.
"Naase na aliyyat kir ketanna".
Rav ushemuel, chad amar: aliyyay perua hayta, vekeruha. vechad amar: achsadra gedola hayta vechillekuha lishnayim.
Bishlama leman deamar achsadra, hayeynu dichtiv "kir" ella leman deamar aliyyay, may "kir"?
Shekkeruha.
Bishlama leman deamar aliyyay, hayeynu dichtiv "aliyyayt". ella leman deamar achsadra, may "aliyyayt"?
"Meulla" shebbabbattim.
"Venasim lo sham mitta veshulchan vechisse umenora".

Amar abbaye, veittema rabbi yitzchak: harotze lehanot — yehane, keelisha. vesheeno rotze lehanot — al yehane, kishmuel haramati. shenneemar: "uteshuvato haramata ki sham beto", veamar rabbi yochanan: shekkol makom shehalach sham — beto immo.
"Vattomer el ishah hinne na yadati ki ish elohim kadosh hu", amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: mikkan shehaishsha makkeret beorchin yoter min haish.
"Kadosh hu": mena yada? rav ushemuel. chad amar: shello raata zevuv over al shulchano, vechad amar: sadin shel pishtan hitztzia al mittato velo raata keri alav.
"Kadosh hu" amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: hu kadosh umesharto eno kadosh. shenneemar: "vayyiggash gechazi lehadfah", amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: sheachazah behod yafyah.
"Over alenu tamid", amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: kol hameareach talmid chacham betoch beto umehannehu minnechasav — maale alav hakkatuv keillu makriv temidin.
Veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: al yaamod adam bemakom gavoah veyitpallel, ella bemakom namuch veyitpallel. shenneemar: "mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai".

Tanya name hachi: lo yaamod adam lo al gabbe kisse, velo al gabbe sherafraf, velo bemakom gavoah, veyitpallel, ella bemakom namuch, veyitpallel. lefi sheen gavhut lifne hammakom. shenneemar "mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai". uchetiv: "tefilla leani chi yaatof".
Veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: hammitpallel tzarich sheyyechavven et raglav, shenneemar: "veraglehem regel yeshara".
(Amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan) veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: may dichtiv, "lo tochlu al haddam" — lo tochlu kodem shettitpallelu al dimchem.

Ikka deamri: amar rabbi yitzchak, amar rabbi yochanan, amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: kol haochel veshote, veachar kach mitpallel alav hakkatuv omer: "veoti hishlachta achare gavvecha", al tikre "gavvecha" ella "geecha". amar hakkadosh baruch hu: leachar shennitgaa ze kibbel alav malchut shamayim.
Rabbi yehoshua omer ad shalosh shaot. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yehoshua.
Hakkore mikkan veelach, lo hifsid.
Amar rav chisda amar mar ukeva: uvilvad shello yomar yotzer or.
Metivi: hakkore mikkan veelach lo hifsid, keadam shehu kore battora, aval mevarech hu shetayim lefaneha veachat leachareha. teyuveta derav chisda, teyuveta.

Ikka deamri amar rav chisda amar mar ukeva: may "lo hifsid" — shello hifsid berachot. tanya name hachi: hakkore mikkan veelach lo hifsid keadam shekkore battora, aval mevarech hu shetayim lefaneha veachat leachareha.
Amar rabbi mani: gadol hakkore keriat shema beonatah yoter mehaosek battora. middekatane: hakkore mikkan veelach lo hifsid keadam hakkore battora. mikkelal dekore beonatah — adif.
Mishna bet shammay omrim: baerev — kol adam yatte veyikra. uvabboker yaamod, shenneemar: "uveshachbecha uvekumecha".
Uvet hillel omrim: kol adam kore kedarko. shenneemar "uvelechtecha vadderech".
Im ken lamma neemar "uveshachbecha uvekumecha" — beshaa shebbene adam shochvim uveshaa shebbene adam omdim.
Amar rabbi tarfon: ani hayiti ba badderech vehitteti likrot kedivre bet shammay. vesikkanti beatzmi mippene hallistim.
Amru lo: keday hayita lachuv beatzmecha, sheavarta al divre bet hillel.

a: Gemara bishlama bet hillel — ka mefarshi tamayyhu vetama devet shammay, ella bet shammay — may tama la amri kevet hillel?
Amri lach bet shammay: im ken, nema kera "babboker uvaerev", may "beshachbecha uvekumecha"? bishat shechiva — shechiva mammash, uvishat kima — kima mammash.
Uvet shammay: hay "uvelechtecha vadderech", may avid lehu?
Hahu mibbee lehu, lechidtanya: "beshivtecha bevetecha" — perat leosek bemitzva, "uvelechtecha vadderech" — perat lechatan. mikkan, amru: hakkones et habbetula — patur, veet haalmana — chayyayv.
May mashma?
Amar rav pappa: ki derech. ma derech reshut, af kol reshut.

Mi la askinan deka azel lidvar mitzva, vaafillu hachi amar rachamana: likre. im ken lichtov rachamana "beshevet uvelechet" may "beshivtecha uvelechtecha"? — beshevet didach uvelechet didach hu demichayyeyvat, ha demitzva petirat.
I hachi afillu kones et haalmana name?
Hay terid, vehay la terid.

I mishshum tirda, afillu tava sefinato bayyam name! vechi tema: hachi name, allema amar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav: avel chayyayv bechol hammitzvot haamurot battora, chutz min hattefillin, shehare neemar bahem "peer", shenneemar: "peercha chavosh alecha"?!
Hatam terid tirda demitzva, hacha terid tirda dirshut.
Uvet shammay?
Hahu mibbee lehu — perat lishluche mitzva.
Uvet hillel amri: mimmela shema minna daafillu vadderech name kare.

Tanu rabbanan, bet hillel omrim: omdin vekorin, yoshvin vekorin, umattin vekorin, holchin badderech vekorin, osin bimlachtan vekorin. umaase berabbi yishmael verabbi elazar ben azarya, shehayu mesubbin bemakom echad, vehaya rabbi yishmael mutte, verabbi elazar ben azarya zakuf. kevan shehiggia zeman keriat shema, hitta rabbi elazar vezakaf rabbi yishmael. amar lo rabbi elazar ben azarya lerabbi yishmael: yishmael achi, emshol lecha mashal lema haddavar dome — mashal leechad sheomrim lo zekancha meguddal! amar lahem: yihye keneged hammashchitim. af kach atta, kol zeman sheani zakuf — atta mutte, achshav kesheani hitteti atta zakafta.
Amar lo: ani asiti kedivre bet hillel, veatta asita kedivre bet shammay. velo od ella shemma yiru hattalmidim veyikbeu halacha ledorot.
May "velo od"?

Vechi tema: bet hillel name it lehu mattin, hane mille dematte vaata meikkara. aval hacha, kevan dead hasheta havet zakuf vehasheta mutte, amri: shema minna kevet shammay sevira lehu, shemma yiru hattalmidim veyikbeu halacha ledorot.
Tane rav yechezkel: asa kedivre bet shammay — asa, kedivre bet hillel — asa.
Rav yosef amar: asa kedivre bet shammay — lo asa velo chelum. ditnan: mi shehaya rosho verubbo bassukka veshulchano betoch habbayit, bet shammay poslin, uvet hillel machshirin.

Amru lahem bet hillel levet shammay: maase shehalchu zikne bet shammay vezikne bet hillel levakker et rabbi yochanan ben hachoranit, metzauhu shehaya rosho verubbo bassukka veshulchano betoch habbayit, velo amru lo kelum.
Amru lahem: umishsham reaya?! af hem amru lo: im ken hayita noheg lo kiyyamta mitzvat sukka miyyamecha.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: asa kedivre bet shammay — chayyayv mita. ditnan, amar rabbi tarfon: ani hayiti ba badderech vehitteti likrot kedivre bet shammay vesikkanti beatzmi mippene hallistim, amru lo: keday hayita lachuv beatzmecha, sheavarta al divre bet hillel.
Mishna bashshachar mevarech shetayim lefaneha veachat leachareha. uvaerev mevarech shetayim lefaneha ushetayim leachareha. achat arukka veachat ketzara.
Makom sheamru lehaarich — eno rashshay lekatztzer, lekatztzer — eno rashshay lehaarich. lachtom — eno rashshay shello lachtom, shello lachtom — eno rashshay lachtom.
Gemara may mevarech?
