Amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi oshaya:
b: "Yotzer or uvore choshech".
Lema: "yotzer or uvore noga"!
Kedichtiv kaamrinan.
Ella meatta "ose shalom uvore ra", mi ka amrinan kedichtiv?! ella ketiv "ra" vekarenan "hakkol" lishshana mealleya, hacha name lema "noga", lishshana mealleya!
Ella amar rava: kede lehazekir middat yom ballayla umiddat layla bayyom.
Bishlama middat layla bayyom kidamrinan: "yotzer or uvore choshech", ella middat yom ballayla, hechi mashkachat la?
Amar abbaye: "golel or mippene choshech vechoshech mippene or".
Veiddach may hi? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: "ahava rabba". vechen ori leh rabbi elazar lerabbi pedat bereh, "ahava rabba".
Tanya name hachi: en omrim "ahavat olam", ella "ahava rabba". verabbanan amri ahavat olam, vechen hu omer: "veahavat olam ahavtich al ken meshachtich chased".
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hishkim lishnot, ad shello kara keriat shema — tzarich levarech. mishshekkara keriat shema — eno tzarich levarech, shekkevar niftar beahava rabba".
Amar rav huna: lammikra tzarich levarech, velammidrash — eno tzarich levarech.
Verabbi elazar amar: lammikra velammidrash tzarich levarech, lammishna — eno tzarich levarech.
Verabbi yochanan amar: af lammishna name tzarich levarech [aval lattalmud, eno tzarich levarech].
Verava amar: af lattalmud tzarich (lachazor ulevarech) [levarech].
Deamar rav chiyyay bar ashe: zimnin saggiin hava kaemna kammeh derav letannoye pirkin besifra deve rav", hava makdem veka mashe yedeh, uvarech, umatne lan pirkin.
May mevarech? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu laasok bedivre tora".

Verabbi yochanan mesayyem ba hachi "haarev na Adonai elohenu et divre toratcha befinu uvefifiyyot ammecha bet yisrael venihye anachnu vetzeetzaenu vetzeetzae ammecha bet yisrael kullanu yode shemecha veoske toratecha baruch atta Adonai hamelammed tora leammo yisrael".
Verav hamenuna amar: "asher bachar banu mikkol haammim venatan lanu et torato. baruch atta Adonai noten hattora". amar rav hamenuna: zo hi meulla shebbabberachot.
Hilkach lemrinhu lechullehu.

Tenan hatam: amar lahem hamemunne: "barchu beracha achat!". vehem berchu. vekaru aseret haddibberot, "shema", "vehaya im shamoa", "vayyomer". uverchu et haam shalosh berachot, "emet veyatztziv", vaavoda, uvirkat kohanim. uveshabbat mosifin beracha achat lammishmar hayyotze.

May "beracha achat"? ki ha derabbi abba verabbi yose bar abba ikkelau lehahu atra, beo minnayyhu: may "beracha achat"? la hava bidayyhu. vaato shayyluhu lerav matna la hava bideh. ato shayyluhu lerav yehuda. amar lehu: hachi amar shemuel, "ahava rabba".

Veamar rabbi zerika, amar rabbi amme, amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: "yotzer or". ki ata rav yitzchak bar yosef, amar, ha derabbi zerika lav beferush ittemar ella mikkelala ittemar. deamar rabbi zerika amar rabbi amme, amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: zot omeret berachot en meakkevot zo et zo.
I amrat bishlama "yotzer or" havo amri, hayeynu divrachot en meakkevot zo et zo, dela ka amri "ahava rabba".

a: Ella, i amrat "ahava rabba" havo amri, may berachot en meakkevot zo et zo? dilma hay dela amri "yotzer or" mishshum dela meta zeman "yotzer or", vechi meta zeman "yotzer or" havo amri.
Vei mikkelala may?
Dei mikkelala, leolam "ahava rabba" havo amri. vechi meta zeman "yotzer or" havo amri leh. umay "berachot en meakkevot zo et zo" — seder berachot.
Vekorin aseret haddibberot "shema", "vehaya im shamoa", "vayyomer", "emet veyatztziv", vaavoda, uvirkat kohanim.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: af bigvulin bikkeshu likrot ken, ella shekkevar bittelum mippene taromet hamminin.
Tanya name hachi, rabbi natan omer: bigvulin bikkeshu likrot ken, ella shekkevar bittelum mippene taromet hamminin.
Rabba bar bar channa sevar lemikbeinhu besura, amar leh rav chisda: kevar bittelum mippene taromet hamminin.
Amemar sevar lemikbeinhu binhardea, amar leh rav ashe: kevar bittelum mippene taromet hamminin.

Uveshabbat mosifin beracha achat lammishmar hayyotze. may beracha achat? amar rabbi chelbo: mishmar hayyotze omer lammishmar hannichnas: "mi sheshshikken et shemo babbayit hazze, hu yashkin benechem ahava veachva veshalom vereut".

Makom sheamru lehaarich. peshita hecha deka naket kasa dechamra bideh vekasavar deshichra hu, ufatach umevarech addata deshichra, vesayyem bidchamra — yatza. dei name im amar "shehakkol nihye bidvaro" — yatza. deha tenan: al kullam im amar "shehakkol nihye bidvaro" — yatza.
Ella hecha deka naket kasa deshichra bideh vekasavar dechamra hu, petach uvarech addata dechamra, vesayyem bidshichra, may?
Batar ikkar beracha azlinan, o batar chatima azlinan?
Ta shema: shacharit, patach beyotzer or" vesiyyem bemaariv aravim" — lo yatza. patach bemaariv aravim" vesiyyem beyotzer or" — yatza.
Arvit, patach bemaariv aravim" vesiyyem beyotzer or" — lo yatza. patach beyotzer or" vesiyyem bemaariv aravim" — yatza.
Kelalo shel davar: hakkol holech achar hachittum.
Shane hatam dekaamar "baruch yotzer hammeorot".
Hanicha lerav deamar kol beracha sheen bah hazekarat hashshem enah beracha — shappir. ella lerabbi yochanan deamar kol beracha sheen bah malchut enah beracha, may ikka lememar?
Ella kevan deamar rabba bar ulla: kede lehazekir middat yom ballayla umiddat layla bayyom, ki kaamar beracha umalchut meikkara — attarvayyhu kaamar.
Ta shema missefa: "kelalo shel davar: hakkol holech achar hachittum". kelalo shel davar leetuye may? lav leetuye ha daamaran?
La, leetuye nahama vetamre. hechi dame? illema daachal nahama, vekasavar detamre achal, ufetach addata detamre vesayyem bidnahama — hayeynu bayayn!
La tzericha: kegon daachal tamre, vekasavar nahama achal, ufetach bidnahama, vesayyem bidtamre [— yatza]. daafillu sayyem bidnahama — name yatza.
May tama — detamre name mezan zayyni.

Amar rabba bar chinnana sava mishshemeh derav: kol shello amar "emet veyatztziv" shacharit, veemet veemuna" arvit — lo yatza yede chovato, shenneemar: "lehaggid babboker chasdecha veemunatcha ballelot".
Veamar rabba bar chinnana [sava] mishshemeh derav: hammitpallel, keshehu korea korea bevaruch, ucheshehu zokef — zokef bashshem
Amar shemuel: may tama derav — dichtiv: "Adonai zokef kefufim".
Metivi: "mippene shemi nichat hu".
Mi ketiv "bishmi"? "mippene shemi" ketiv.
Amar leh shemuel lechiyyay bar rav: bar oryan, ta veema lecha milleta meallayyta deamar avuch. hachi amar avuch: keshehu korea — korea bevaruch", keshehu zokef — zokef bashshem.
b: Rav sheshet, ki kara — kara kechizra. ki ka zakef — zakef kechivya.

Veamar rabba bar chinnana sava mishshemeh derav kol hashshana kullah adam mitpallel "hael hakkadosh", "melech ohev tzedaka umishpat", chutz measara yamim shebben rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim, shemmitpallel "hammelech hakkadosh", vehammelech hammishpat".

Verabbi elazar amar afillu amar "hael hakkadosh" — yatza. shenneemar: "vayyigba Adonai tzevaot bammishpat vehael hakkadosh nikdash bitzdaka". ematay "vayyigba Adonai tzevaot bammishpat" — ellu asara yamim shemmerosh hashshana vead yom hakkippurim, vekaamar "hael hakkadosh".
May hava ala?
Amar rav yosef: "hael hakkadosh" umelech ohev tzedaka umishpat". rabba amar: "hammelech hakkadosh" vehammelech hammishpat". vehilcheta kerabba.

Veamar rabba bar chinnana sava mishshemeh derav: kol sheefshar lo levakkesh rachamim al chavero veeno mevakkesh — nikra "chote". shenneemar: "gam anochi chalila li mechato laAdonai mechadol lehitpallel baadchem".
Amar rava: im talmid chacham hu, tzarich sheyyachale atzmo alav.
May tama? illema mishshum dichtiv: "veen chole mikkem alay veen gole et azni" — dilma melech shane. ella mehacha: "vaani bachalotam levushi vegomer".

Veamar rabba bar chinnana sava mishshemeh derav: kol haose devar avera umitbayyesh bo — mochalin lo al kol avonotav. shenneemar: "lemaan tizkeri vavosht velo yihye lach od pitchon pe mippene kelimmatech bechapperi lach lechol asher asit neum Adonai elohim".

Dilma tzibbur shane. ella mehacha: "vayyomer shemuel el shaul lamma hirgaztani lehaalot oti vayyomer shaul tzar li meod ufelishtim nilchamim bi vaAdonai sar mealay velo anani od gam beyad hanneviim gam bachalomot vaekrae lecha lehodieni ma eese". veillu "urim vetummim" la kaamar.
Mishshum dekatleh lenov ir hakkohanim.
Uminnayin deachilu leh min shemayya — shenneemar: "vayyomer shemuel el shaul (machar) [umachar] atta uvanecha immi", veamar rabbi yochanan "immi" — bimchitzati.
Verabbanan amri, mehacha: "vehokanum laAdonai begivat shaul bechir Adonai". yatzta bat kol veamra "bechir Adonai".
Amar rabbi avahu ben zutarti amar rabbi yehuda bar zevida: bikkeshu likboa parashat balak bikriat shema, umippene ma lo kevauha — mishshum torach tzibbur.
May tama? illema mishshum dichtiv bah: "el motziam mimmitzrayim" — lema parashat ribbit ufarashat mishkalot dichtiv bahen yetziat mitzrayim.
Ella amar rabbi yose bar avin, mishshum dichtiv bah hay kera: "kara shachav kaari uchelavi mi yekimennu".
Velema hay pesuka vetu la.
Gemiri: kol parasha defaska moshe rabbenu — paskinan, dela paska moshe rabbenu — la paskinan.
Parashat tzitzit mippene ma kevauha?
Amar rabbi yehuda bar chaviva, mippene sheyyesh bah chamishsha devarim: mitzvat tzitzit, yetziat mitzrayim, ol mitzvot, vedaat minim, hirhur avera, vehirhur avoda zara.

Bishlama hane telat mefarshan. ol mitzvot, dichtiv: "ureitem oto uzechartem et kol mitzvot Adonai". tzitzit, dichtiv: "veasu lahem tzitzit vegomer". yetziat mitzrayim, dichtiv: "asher hotzeti vegomer". ella: daat minim, hirhur avera, vehirhur avoda zara — menalan?

Detanya: "achare levavchem" — zo minut, vechen hu omer: "amar naval belibbo en elohim". "achare enechem" — ze hirhur avera, shenneemar: "vayyomer shimshon el aviv otah kach li, ki hi yashra veenay". "attem zonim" — ze hirhur avoda zara, vechen hu omer "vayyiznu achare habbealim".
Mishna mazkirin yetziat mitzrayim ballelot. amar rabbi elazar ben azarya: hare ani keven shivim shana, velo zachiti shetteamer yetziat mitzrayim ballelot, ad shedderashah ben zoma.
Shenneemar "lemaan tizkor et yom tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim kol yeme chayyecha". "yeme chayyecha" — hayyamim, "kol yeme chayyecha" — hallelot.
Vachachamim omrim: "yeme chayyecha" — haolam hazze. "kol" — lehavi limot hammashiach.

Gemara tanya, amar lahem ben zoma lachachamim: vechi mazkirin yetziat mitzrayim limot hammashiach! vahalo kevar neemar "hinne yamim baim neum Adonai velo yomru od chay Adonai asher heela et bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim ki im chay Adonai asher heela vaasher hevi et zera bet yisrael meeretz tzafona umikkol haaratzot asher hiddachtim sham".
Amru lo: lo shetteaker yetziat mitzrayim mimmekomah, ella shettehe shibud malchuyot ikkar, vitziat mitzrayim tafel lo.
Kayyotze bo atta omer: "lo yikkare shimcha od yaakov ki im yisrael yihye shemecha",

a: Lo sheyyeaker "yaakov" mimmekomo, ella "yisrael" ikkar veyaakov" tafel lo. vechen hu omer "al tizkeru rishonot vekadmoniyyot al titbonanu": al tizkeru rishonot" — ze shibud malchuyot, "vekadmoniyyot al titbonanu" — zo yetziat mitzrayim.
"Hinni ose chadasha atta titzmach", tane rav yosef: zo milchemet gog umagog.

Mashal lema haddavar dome — leadam shehaya mehallech badderech ufaga bo zeev venitztzal mimmennu, vehaya mesapper veholech maase zeev. paga bo ari venitztzal mimmennu, vehaya mesapper veholech maase ari. paga bo nachash venitztzal mimmennu, shachach maase shenehem, vehaya mesapper veholech maase nachash. af kach yisrael — tzarot acharonot meshakkechot et harishonot.
"Avram hu avraham":
Battechilla naasa av laaram, ulevassof naasa av lechol haolam kullo.
"Saray hi sara".
Battechilla naaset saray leummatah, ulevassof naaset sara lechol haolam kullo.
Tane bar kappara: kol hakkore leavraham "avram" — over baase. shenneemar: "vehaya shimcha avraham". rabbi eliezer omer: over belav, shenneemar: "velo yikkare od [et] shimcha avram".
Ella meatta hakkore lesara "saray" hachi name?
Hatam, kudesha berich hu amar leavraham: "saray ishtecha lo tikra et shemah saray ki sara shemah".
Ella meatta hakkore leyaakov "yaakov" hachi name?!
Shane hatam dahadar ahdereh kera, dichtiv: "vayyomer elohim leyisrael bemarot hallayla vayyomer yaakov yaakov".
Metiv rabbi yose bar avin, veittema rabbi yose bar zevida: "atta hu Adonai haelohim asher bacharta beavram"!
Amar leh hatam navi hu deka mesaddar leshivcheh derachamana may dahava meikkara.
Haderan alach meematay
Mishna haya kore battora vehiggia zeman hammikra, im kivvevn libbo — yatza.
Bapperakim, shoel mippene hakkavod umeshiv. uveemtza, shoel mippene hayyira umeshiv, divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi yehuda omer: baemtza, shoel mippene hayyira umeshiv mippene hakkavod. uvapperakim, shoel mippene hakkavod umeshiv shalom lechol adam.
Ellu hen ben happerakim: ben beracha rishona lashsheniyya, ben sheniyya lishma", ben "shema" livhaya im shamoa", ben "vehaya im shamoa" levayyomer", ben "vayyomer" leemet veyatztziv".
Rabbi yehuda omer: ben "vayyomer" leemet veyatztziv" — lo yafsik.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben karcha: lamma kadma parashat "shema" levhaya im shamoa" — kede sheyyekabbel alav ol malchut shamayim techilla, veachar kach mekabbel alav ol mitzvot. "vehaya im shamoa" levayyomer" — shevhaya im shamoa" noheg ben bayyom uven ballayla, "vayyomer" eno noheg ella bayyom bilvad.
Gemara shema minna mitzvot tzerichot kavvavna.
May "im kivvevn libbo" — likrot. likrot?! veha ka kare!
Bekore lehaggiah.
Tanu rabbanan: keriat shema kichtavah, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: bechol lashon.
May tama derabbi? amar kera "vehayu" bahavayaytan yehu.
Verabbanan, may tamayyhu? amar kera: "shema" — bechol lashon sheatta shomea.
Ulerabbi name, ha ketiv "shema"! hahu mibbee leh: hashema leaznecha ma sheatta motzi mippicha.
Verabbanan? savri la keman deamar lo hishmia leazno — yatza.
Ulerabbanan name ha ketiv "vehayu"? hahu mibbee lehu shello yikra lemafrea.
Verabbi, shello yikra lemafrea mena leh? nafka leh middevarim" "haddevarim". verabbanan, "devarim" "haddevarim" — la darshi.
Lememra desavar rabbi dechol hattora kullah bechol lashon neemra. dei salka datach bilshon hakkodesh neemra, "vehayu" dichtav rachamana lema li?
Itzterich mishshum dichtiv "shema".
Lememra desavri rabbanan dechol hattora kullah bilshon hakkodesh neemra. dei salka datach bechol lashon neemra, "shema" dichtav rachamana lema li?!
Itzterich mishshum dichtiv "vehayu".

Tanu rabbanan: "vehayu" shello yikra lemafrea. "haddevarim … al levavecha" — yachol tehe kol happarasha tzericha kavvavna? — talmud lomar "haelle". ad kan tzericha kavvavna, mikkan veelach en tzericha kavvavna. divre rabbi eliezer.
Amar lo rabbi akiva: hare hu omer:
b: "Asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom al levavecha". mikkan atta lamed shekkol happarasha kullah tzericha kavvavna.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi akiva.

Ikka dematne la aha detanya. hakkore et shema tzarich sheyyechavven et libbo, rabbi acha mishshum rabbi yehuda omer: kevan shekkivvevn libbo beferek rishon shuv eno tzarich. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi acha sheamar mishshum rabbi yehuda.

Tanya idach. "vehayu" — shello yikra lemafrea. "al levavecha" — rav zutera omer ad kan mitzvat kavvavna, mikkan veelach mitzvat keria. rabbi yoshiyya omer: ad kan mitzvat keria, mikkan veelach mitzvat kavvavna.
May shena mikkan veelach mitzvat keria — dichtiv: "ledabber bam"? hacha name ha chetiv "vedibbarta bam"!
Hachi kaamar: ad kan mitzvat kavvavna ukeria, mikkan veelach — keria belo kavvavna.
Umay shena ad kan mitzvat kavvavna ukeria dichtiv "al levavecha … vedibbarta bam". hatam name ha ketiv "al levavchem … ledabber bam".
Hahu mibbee leh lechidrabbi yitzchak deamar: "vesamtem et devaray elle" — tzericha shettehe sima keneged hallev.

Amar mar, rabbi yoshiyya omer: ad kan mitzvat keria, mikkan veelach — mitzvat kavvavna. may shena mikkan veelach mitzvat kavvavna — mishshum dichtiv "al levavchem", hacha name ha ketiv "al levavecha"!
Hachi kaamar: ad kan, mitzvat keria vechavvavna, mikkan veelach — kavvavna belo keria.
Umay shena ad kan mitzvat keria vechavvavna — dichtiv "al levavecha" "vedibbarta bam", hatam name ha ketiv "al levavchem … ledabber bam"!
Hahu bedivre tora ketiv. vehachi kaamar rachamana: agmiru benayychu tora, ki hechi deligresu behu.
Tanu rabbanan: "shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad" — ad kan tzericha kavvavnat hallev, divre rabbi meir. amar rava: halacha kerabbi meir.
Tanya somchos omer: kol hammaarich beechad", maarichin lo yamav ushenotav. amar rav acha bar yaakov: uvaddalet. amar rav ashe: uvilvad shello yachatof bachet.
Rabbi yirmeya hava yatev kammeh derabbi [chiyyay bar abba], chazyeh dahava maarech tuva, amar leh: kevan deamlechteh lemala ulematta ulearba ruchot hashshamayim — tu la tzerichat.

Amar rav natan bar mar ukeva amar rav yehuda: "al levavecha" baamida. "al levavecha" salka datach?! ella ema ad "al levavecha" baamida. mikkan veelach — lo. verabbi yochanan amar kol happarasha kullah baamida.
Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh, deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi acha sheamar mishshum rabbi yehuda.

Tanu rabbanan: "shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad" zo keriat shema shel rabbi yehuda hannasi. amar leh rav lerabbi chiyyay: la chazena leh lerabbi dimkabbel aleh malchut shamayim. amar leh: bar pachate, beshaa shemmaavir yadav al panav, mekabbel alav ol malchut shamayim.

Chozer vegomrah, o eno chozer vegomrah? bar kappara omer: eno chozer vegomrah. rabbi shimon berabbi omer: chozer vegomrah. amar leh bar kappara lerabbi shimon berabbi: bishlama ledidi deamena "eno chozer vegomrah", hayeynu dimhaddar rabbi ashshemata deit ba yetziat mitzrayim. ella ledidach deamrat chozer vegomrah, lema leh leahdore?
Kede lehazekir yetziat mitzrayim bizmannah.

Amar rabbi ila bereh derav shemuel bar marta mishshemeh derav: amar "shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad" veneenas beshena — yatza. amar leh rav nachman ledaru avdeh: bifsuka kamma — tzaaran, tefe — la tetzaaran. amar leh rav yosef lerav yosef bereh derabba: avuch hechi hava aved? amar leh: bifsuka kamma hava ka metzaar nafsheh, tefe — la hava metzaar nafsheh.
Amar rav yosef: perakdan, lo yikra keriat shema. mikra hu dela likre, ha migna shappir dame? veha rabbi yehoshua ben levi layet amman degane apparkid!
Amri, migna ki matzle — shappir dame, mikra af al gav dematzle name — asur.
Veha rabbi yochanan matzle vekare!
Shane rabbi yochanan devaal basar hava.
Bapperakim shoel vechulei.
Meshiv mechamat may? illema mippene hakkavod, hasheta mishal shael, ahdore mibbaya?! ella: shoel — mippene hakkavod, umeshiv shalom — lechol adam. ema sefa: "uvaemtza shoel mippene hayyira, umeshiv".

Meshiv mechamat may? illema mippene hayyira — hasheta mishal shael, ahdore mibbaya? ella — mippene hakkavod. hayeynu derabbi yehuda! — ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: baemtza — shoel mippene hayyira umeshiv mippene hakkavod, uvapperakim — shoel mippene hakkavod umeshiv shalom lechol adam?

Chassore mechassera, vehachi katane: bapperakim — shoel mippene hakkavod, veen tzarich lomar shehu meshiv. uvaemtza — shoel mippene hayyira, veen tzarich lomar shehu meshiv, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: baemtza — shoel mippene hayyira umeshiv mippene hakkavod,

a: Uvapperakim — shoel mippene hakkavod umeshiv shalom lechol adam.

Tanya name hachi: hakkore et shema ufaga bo rabbo o gadol hemennu, bapperakim — shoel mippene hakkavod veen tzarich lomar shehu meshiv, uvaemtza — shoel mippene hayyira veen tzarich lomar shehu meshiv. divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: baemtza — shoel mippene hayyira umeshiv mippene hakkavod, uvapperakim — shoel mippene hakkavod umeshiv shalom lechol adam.

Bea minneh achay tanna deve rabbi chiyyay merabbi chiyyay: behallel uvamgilla mahu sheyyafsik? amrinan kal vachomer: keriat shema deorayyta — posek, hallel derabbanan mibbaya?! o dilma parsome nissa adif.

Amar leh: posek, veen bechach kelum. amar rabba: yamim shehayyachid gomer bahen et hahallel, ben perek leferek posek, beemtza happerek — eno posek, veyamim sheen hayyachid gomer bahen et hahallel — afillu beemtza happerek posek.
Ini?! veha rav bar sheva ikkela legabbeh deravina, veyamim sheen hayyachid gomer et hahallel hava, vela pesek leh!
Shane rav bar sheva dela chashiv aleh deravina.
Bea minneh ashyan tanna deve rabbi amme merabbi amme: hashsharuy betaanit mahu sheyyitom? achila ushetiyya kabbel aleh — veha lekka. o dilma: hanaa kabbel aleh — veha ikka.
Amar leh: toem veen bechach kelum. tanya name hachi: matemet enah teuna beracha, vehashsharuy betaanit toem veen bechach kelum.
Ad kamma?
Rabbi amme verabbi assi taami ad shiur reviata.
Amar rav: kol hannoten shalom lachavero kodem sheyyitpallel keillu asao bama. shenneemar: "chidlu lachem min haadam asher neshama beappo ki vamme nechshav hu". al tikre, "bamme" ella "bama".
Ushemuel amar: bamme chashavto laze velo laeloah?
Metiv rav sheshet: bapperakim shoel mippene hakkavod umeshiv!
Targema rabbi abba: bemashkim lefitcho.
Amar rabbi yona amar rabbi zera: kol haose chafatzav kodem sheyyitpallel — keillu bana bama. amru lo "bama" amrat? amar lehu: la, "asur" ka amena.
(Vechidrav idi bar avin deamar) rav idi bar avin amar rav yitzchak bar ashyan: asur lo laadam laasot chafatzav kodem sheyyitpallel, shenneemar: "tzedek lefanav yehallech veyasem lederech peamav".

Veamar rav idi bar avin amar rav yitzchak bar ashyan: kol hammitpallel veachar kach yotze ladderech, hakkadosh baruch hu ose lo chafatzav, shenneemar: "tzedek lefanav yehallech veyasem lederech peamav".
Veamar rabbi yona amar rabbi zera: kol hallan shivat yamim belo chalom nikra "ra", shenneemar: "vesavea yalin bal yippaked ra", al tikre "savea" ella "sheva".

Amar leh rav acha bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba: hachi amar rabbi chiyyay amar rabbi yochanan: kol hammasbia atzmo middivre tora velan — en mevasserin oto besorot raot, shenneemar: "vesavea yalin bal yippaked ra".
Ellu hen ben happerakim vechulei.
Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi yehuda deamar ben "elohechem" leemet veyatztziv" lo yafsik. amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: may tameh derabbi yehuda — dichtiv:
b: "VaAdonai elohim emet".
Chozer veomer "emet", o eno chozer veomer "emet"?

Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: chozer veomer "emet". rabba amar: eno chozer veomer "emet". hahu dinchet kammeh derabba. shameh rabba deamar "emet" "emet" tere zimne. amar rabba: kol "emet" "emet" tafseh lehay.
Amar rav yosef: kamma mealleya ha shemateta, dechi ata rav shemuel bar yehuda amar: amri bemareva arvit — "dabber el bene yisrael veamarta alehem ani Adonai elohechem emet".

Amar leh abbaye: may mealleyuta? veha amar rav kahana amar rav: lo yatchil, veim hitchil — gomer. vechi tema "veamarta alehem" la have hatechala — vehaamar rav shemuel bar yitzchak amar rav: "dabber el bene yisrael" la have hatechala, "veamarta alehem" have hatechala.
Amar rav pappa: kasavri bemareva "veamarta alehem" name la havya hatechala ad deamar "veasu lahem tzitzit".
Amar abbaye: hilkach, anan atchole matchalinan, deka matchali bemareva, vechevan deatchalinan — migmar name gamrinan. deha amar rav kahana amar rav lo yatchil, veim hitchil gomer.
Chiyyay bar rav amar: amar "ani Adonai elohechem", tzarich lomar "emet". lo amar "ani Adonai elohechem" — eno tzarich lomar "emet".
Veha bae leadkore yetziat mitzrayim!
Deamar hachi: "modim anachnu lach Adonai elohenu shehotzetanu meeretz mitzrayim ufeditanu mibbet avadim veasita lanu nissim ugevurot al hayyam vesharnu lach".
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha: lamma kadma parashat "shema" vechulei.
Tanya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: baddin hu sheyyakdim "shema", livhaya im shamoa" — shezze lilmod, veze lelammed. "vehaya im shamoa" levayyomer" — shezze lilmod, veze laasot.

Attu "shema" — lilmod it beh, lelammed velaasot let beh?! veha ketiv: "veshinnantam", "ukeshartam", "uchetavtam"! vetu: "vehaya im shamoa" — lelammed hu deit beh, velaasot let beh? veha ketiv: "ukeshartem", "uchetavtam"!

Ella hachi kaamar: baddin hu shettikdam "shema" livhaya im shamoa", shezze lilmod ulelammed velaasot. "vehaya im shamoa" levayyomer", shezze yesh bah lelammed velaasot, "vayyomer" en bah ella laasot bilvad.

Vetippok leh midderabbi yehoshua ben korcha! chada veod kaamar, chada: kede sheyyekabbel alav ol malchut shamayim techilla veachar kach yekabbel alav ol mitzvot, veod — mishshum deit ba hane mille achranyayta.

Rav meshi yedeh, ukera keriat shema, veannach tefillin vetzalli. vehechi aved hachi? vehatanya hachofer kuch lemet bakkever — patur mikkeriat shema umin hattefilla umin hattefillin umikkol mitzvot haamurot battora. higgia zeman keriat shema — ole venotel yadav, umanniach tefillin, vekore keriat shema, umitpallel.
Ha gufa kashya, resha amar patur, vesefa chayyayv?!
Ha la kashya: sefa bitre, veresha bechad.
Mikkol makom kashya lerav. rav kerabbi yehoshua ben karcha sevira leh, deamar ol malchut shamayim techilla veachar kach ol mitzvot.
Emar daamar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha — lehakedim keria likria, keria laasiyya mi shamat leh?!

Vetu, mi savar leh kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha? vehaamar rav chiyyay bar ashe: zimnin saggiin hava kaemna kammeh derav, umakdem umashe yedeh, umevarech, umatne lan pirkin, umannach tefillin, vahadar kare keriat shema. vechi tema: bidla meta zeman keriat shema, im ken may ashadteh derav chiyyay bar ashe?
Leappoke mimman deamar lammishna en tzarich levarech, kamashma lan deaf lemishna name tzarich levarech.
Mikkol makom kashya lerav! shelucha hu deavvet.
Amar ulla: kol hakkore keriat shema belo tefillin, keillu meid edut sheker beatzmo. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: keillu hikriv ola belo mincha, vezevach belo nesachim.
Veamar rabbi yochanan: harotze sheyyekabbel alav ol malchut shamayim shelema

a: Yippane, veyittol yadav, veyanniach tefillin, veyikra keriat shema, veyitpallel, vezo hi malchut shamayim shelema.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol hannifne, venotel yadav, umanniach tefillin, vekore keriat shema, umitpallel — maale alav hakkatuv keillu bana mizbeach vehikriv alav korban, dichtiv: "erchatz benikkayon kappay vaasovva et mizbachacha Adonai". amar leh rava: la savar la mar keillu taval, dichtiv: "erchatz [benikkayon]" — vela katav "architz [kappay]".
Amar leh ravina lerava: chazi mar hay tzureba merabbanan daata mimmareva veamar: mi sheen lo mayim lirchotz yadav — mekanneach yadav beafar uvitzror uvekismit.
Amar leh: shappir kaamar, mi ketiv "erchatz bemayim"? "benikkayon" ketiv — kol midde dimnakke, deha rav chisda layet amman dimhaddar ammayya beiddan tzelota.
Vehane mille likriat shema, aval litfilla mehaddar. vead kamma? — ad parsa. vehane mille lekammeh, aval laachoreh — afillu mil eno chozer. [uminna] mil hu deeno chozer, ha pachot mimmil — chozer.
Mishna hakkore et shema velo hishmia leozno — yatza. rabbi yose omer: lo yatza.
Kara velo dikdek beotiyyoteha, rabbi yose omer: yatza. rabbi yehuda omer: lo yatza.
Hakkore lemafrea — lo yatza. kara vetaa — yachzor limkom shettaa.
Gemara may tama derabbi yose? mishshum dichtiv "shema" — hashema leoznecha ma sheatta motzi mippicha. vetanna kamma savar, "shema" — bechol lashon sheatta shomea.
Verabbi yose, tarte shema minna.
Tenan hatam: cheresh hamedabber veeno shomea — lo yitrom. veim taram — terumato teruma.
Man tena cheresh hamedabber veeno shomea diavad — in, lechattechilla — la?
Amar rav chisda: rabbi yose hi, ditnan: hakkore et "shema" velo hishmia leozno — yatza, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: lo yatza.
Ad kan la kaamar rabbi yose lo yatza, ella gabbe keriat shema deorayyta, aval teruma — mishshum beracha hu, uveracha derabbanan vela bivracha talya milleta.
Umimmay derabbi yose hi, dilma rabbi yehuda hi? veamar gabbe keriat shema name diavad — in, lechattechilla — la. teda, dekatane: "hakkore", diavad — in, lechattechilla — la.
Amri: hay dekatane "hakkore", lehodiacha kocho derabbi yose deamar diavad name la. dei rabbi yehuda, afillu lechattechilla name yatza.
Bemay okimta — kerabbi yose? veella ha detanya: lo yevarech adam birkat hammazon belibbo, veim berach — yatza.
Manni? la rabbi yose vela rabbi yehuda. dei rabbi yehuda — ha amar, lechattechilla name yatza? i rabbi yose, diavad name la!
Ella may, rabbi yehuda. vediavad — in, lechattechilla — la.
Ella ha detane rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi: cheresh hamedabber veeno shomea — torem lechattechilla, manni?
La rabbi yehuda vela rabbi yose. i rabbi yehuda — ha amar diavad in, lechattechilla la. i rabbi yose — ha amar diavad name la?

Ella, leolam rabbi yehuda, vaafillu lechattechilla name. vela kashya, ha — dideh, ha — derabbeh. ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya: hakkore et shema tzarich sheyyashmia leozno, shenneemar: "shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad". amar lo rabbi meir: hare hu omer "asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom al levavecha" — achar kavvanat hallev hen hen haddevarim.
Hasheta deatet lehachi, afillu tema rabbi yehuda kerabbeh sevira leh. vela kashya: ha rabbi meir, ha rabbi yehuda.
Tenan hatam: hakkol kesherim likrot et hammegilla, chutz mecheresh, shote vekatan. verabbi yehuda machshir bekatan.
Man tana cheresh diavad name la? amar rav matna: rabbi yose hi. ditnan: hakkore et "shema" velo hishmia leozno — yatza, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: lo yatza.
Mimmay derabbi yose hi vediavad name la,
b: Dilma rabbi yehuda hi, ulechattechilla hu dela, ha diavad — shappir dame.
La salka datach, dekatane, cheresh dumeya deshote vekatan. ma shote vekatan diavad name la — af cheresh diavad name la.
Vedilma ha kidita veha kidita.
Umi matzet leokma kerabbi yehuda? veha middekatane sefa: rabbi yehuda machshir bekatan, mikkelal deresha lav rabbi yehuda hi?!

Vedilma kulla rabbi yehuda hi utere gavvne katan, vechassore mechassera, vehachi katane: hakkol kesherin likrot et hammegilla, chutz mecheresh shote vekatan. bamme devarim amurim — bekatan shello higgia lechinnuch, aval katan shehiggia lechinnuch — afillu lechattechilla kasher, divre rabbi yehuda, sherabbi yehuda machshir bekatan.
Bemay okimta, kerabbi yehuda — vediavad in, lechattechilla la? ella ha detane rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi, cheresh hamedabber veeno shomea — torem lechattechilla,
Manni? la rabbi yehuda vela rabbi yose. i rabbi yehuda, diavad in lechattechilla la. i rabbi yose, diavad name la!
Ella may, rabbi yehuda — vaafillu lechattechilla name? ella ha detanya: lo yevarech adam birkat hammazon belibbo, veim berech — yatza, manni?
La rabbi yehuda vela rabbi yose. i rabbi yehuda, ha amar afillu lechattechilla name, vei rabbi yose, ha amar afillu diavad name la!

Leolam rabbi yehuda hi, vaafillu lechattechilla name. vela kashya ha — dideh, ha — derabbeh. detanya, amar rabbi yehuda mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya: hakkore et shema tzarich sheyyashmia leozno, shenneemar: "shema yisrael". amar lo rabbi meir: hare hu omer: "asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom al levavecha", achar kavvanat hallev hen hen haddevarim.
Hasheta deatet lehachi, afillu tema rabbi yehuda kerabbeh sevira leh, vela kashya, ha — rabbi yehuda, ha — rabbi meir.
Amar rav chisda amar rav shela: halacha kerabbi yehuda sheamar mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya, vahalacha kerabbi yehuda.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan halacha kerabbi yehuda, hava amena afillu lechattechilla, kamashma lan halacha kerabbi yehuda sheamar mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya.
Vei ashmeinan halacha kerabbi yehuda sheamar mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya, hava amena tzarich veen lo takkana. kamashma lan halacha kerabbi yehuda.
Amar rav yosef: machaloket bikriat shema, aval bishar mitzvot — divre hakkol lo yatza, dichtiv: "haseket ushema yisrael".

Metivi: lo yevarech adam birkat hammazon belibbo, veim berech — yatza. ella i ittemar — hachi ittemar: amar rav yosef machaloket bikriat shema, dichtiv "shema yisrael", aval bishar mitzvot — divre hakkol yatza.
Vehachtiv "haseket ushema yisrael"!
Hahu bedivre tora ketiv.
"Kara velo dikdek beotiyyoteha".
Amar rabbi tavi amar rabbi yoshiyya: halacha kedivre shenehem lehakel.

Veamar rabbi tavi amar rabbi yoshiyya: may dichtiv "shalosh henna lo tisbana. sheol veotzer racham". vechi ma inyan sheol etzel rechem? ella lomar lach: ma rechem machnis umotzi, af sheol machnis umotzi.

Vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma rechem shemmachnisin bo bachashay, motziin mimmennu bekole kolot. sheol shemmachnisin bo bekole kolot, eno din shemmotziin mimmennu bekole kolot? mikkan teshuva laomrim en techiyyayt hammetim min hattora.
Tane rabbi oshaya kammeh derava: "uchetavtam" — hakkol bichtav, afillu tzavvaot.

Amar leh: daamar lach manni — rabbi yehuda hi, deamar gabbe sota — alot kotev, tzavvaot eno kotev. vehatam hu dichtiv: "vechatav et haalot haelle", aval hacha dichtiv: "uchetavtam" — afillu tzavvaot name.
Attu tameh derabbi yehuda mishshum dichtiv "vechatav"? tameh derabbi yehuda mishshum dichtiv "alot". alot in, tzavvaot — la.
Itzterich, salka datach amena nelaf "ketiva" "ketiva" mehatam: ma hatam — alot in, tzavvaot la. af hacha name — tzavvaot la. ketav rachamana "uchetavtam" — afillu tzavvaot.
Tane rav ovadya kammeh derava: "velimmadtem" sheyyehe limmudecha tam — sheyyitten revach ben haddevakim.
Ane rava batreh: kegon "al levavecha", "al levavchem", "bechol levavcha", "bechol levavchem", "esev besadcha", "vaavadtem mehera", "hakkanaf petil", "etchem meeretz".

Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: kol hakkore keriat shema umedakdek beotiyyoteha metzannenin lo gehinnam, shenneemar: "befares shadday melachim bah tashleg betzalmon" — al tikre "befares" ella "befaresh", al tikre "betzalmon" ella "betzalmavet".
Veamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: lamma nismechu

a: Ohalim linchalim, dichtiv: "kinchalim nittayu kegannot ale nahar kaahalim nata vegomer" — lomar lecha: ma nechalim maalin et haadam mittumea letohora — af ohalim maalin et haadam mikkaf chova lechaf zechut.
"Hakkore lemafrea lo yatza vechulei".

Rabbi amme verabbi assi havo ka katrin leh genana lerabbi elazar. amar lehu: addehachi vehachi ezil veeshma milleta deve midresha, veete veema lechu. azal ashkecheh letanna dekatane kammeh derabbi yochanan:
Kara vetaa veeno yodea lehechan taa, beemtza happerek — yachzor larosh. ben perek leferek — yachzor leferek rishon. ben ketiva lichtiva — yachzor lichtiva rishona.
Amar leh rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella shello patach bilmaan yirbu yemechem", aval patach bilmaan yirbu yemechem" — sircheh naket veate.
Ata vaamar lehu. amaru leh: illu lo banu ella lishmoa davar ze — dayyenu.
Mishna haummanin — korin berosh hailan uverosh hannidbach. ma sheenan rashshain laasot ken battefilla.

Chatan patur mikkeriat shema layla harishona vead motzae shabbat im lo asa maase. umaase berabban gamliel shennasa ishsha vekara layla harishona. amru lo talmidav: limmadtanu rabbenu shechatan patur mikkeriat shema? amar lahem eni shomea lachem levattel hemeni malchut shamayim afillu shaa achat.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: haummanin — korin berosh hailan uverosh hannidbach. umitpallelin berosh hazzayit uverosh hatteena. ushear kol hailanot — yordim lematta umitpallelin. uvaal habbayit, ben kach uven kach yored lematta umitpallel, lefi sheen dato meyushshevet alav.

Rame leh rav mari bera devat shemuel lerava, tenan: haummanin korin berosh hailan uverosh hannidbach, alma la bae kavvana. ureminhi: hakkore et shema tzarich sheyyechavven et libbo, shenneemar: "shema yisrael", ulehallan hu omer: "haseket ushema yisrael". ma lehallan behaseket" af kan behaseket".
Ishtik. amar leh: midde shemia lach beha? amar leh: hachi amar rav sheshet — vehu shebbetelin mimmelachtan vekorin.
Vehatanya: bet hillel omrim oskim bimlachtan vekorin!
La kashya: ha beferek rishon, ha beferek sheni.

Tanu rabbanan: happoalim shehayu osin melacha etzel baal habbayit, korin keriat shema umevarchin lefaneha uleachareha. veochlin pittan umevarchin lefaneha uleachareha, umitpallelin tefilla shel shemone esre. aval en yordin lifne hatteva, veen nosin kappehem.
Vehatanya meen shemone esre! amar rav sheshet: la kashya, ha — rabban gamliel, ha — rabbi yehoshua.
I rabbi yehoshua, may irya poalim? afillu kol adam name!
Ella idde veidde rabban gamliel, vela kashya: kan, beosin bischaran. kan, beosin bisudatan.

Vehatanya: happoalim shehayu osim melacha etzel baal habbayit — korin keriat shema umitpallelin. veochlin pittan — veen mevarchim lefaneha, aval mevarchin leachareha shetayim. ketzad? beracha rishona ketikkunah, sheniyya poteach bevirkat haaretz vechollin "bone yerushalayim" bevirkat haaretz.
Bamme devarim amurim — beosin bischaran, aval osin bisudatan o shehaya baal habbayit mesev immahen — mevarchin ketikkunah.

Chatan patur mikkeriat shema. tanu rabbanan: "beshivtecha bevetecha" — perat leosek bemitzva. "uvelechtecha badderech" — perat lechatan. mikkan amru: hakkones et habbetula — patur, veet haalmana — chayyayv.
May mashma? amar rav pappa: ki derech. ma derech reshut, af hacha name reshut.
Mi la askinan dekaazel lidvar mitzva, vaafillu hachi amar rachamana: likre.
Im ken, lema kera "belechet", may "belechtecha" — shema minna: belechet didach hu dimchayyeyvat, ha demitzva — petirat.
b: I hachi may irya hakkones et habbetula? afillu kones et haalmana name.
Hacha — terid, vehacha — la terid.

I mishshum tirda, afillu tava sefinato bayyam name, allema amar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav: avel chayyayv bechol mitzvot haamurot battora, chutz min hattefillin shehare neemar bahen "peer", shenneemar "peercha chavosh alecha vegomer"!
Amri hatam tirda dirshut hacha tirda demitzva.
Mishna rachatz layla harishon shemmeta ishto. amru lo talmidav: limmadtanu rabbenu sheavel asur lirchotz? amar lahem eni kishar bene adam, istenis ani.
Ucheshemmet tavi avdo kibbel alav tanchumin. amru lo talmidav: limmadtanu rabbenu sheen mekabbelin tanchumin al haavadim? amar lahem: en tavi avdi kishar kol haavadim, kasher haya.
Chatan im rotze likrot keriat shema layla harishon — kore, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: lo kol harotze littol et hashshem, yittol.
Gemara may tama derabban (shimon ben) gamliel? kasavar: aninut layla — derabbanan, dichtiv: "veacharitah keyom mar". uvimkom istenis la gezaru beh rabbanan.
Ucheshemmet tavi avdo vechulei.
Tanu rabbanan: avadim ushefachot en omdin alehem beshura, veen omrim alehem birkat avelim vetanchume avelim.

Maase umeta shifchato shel rabbi eliezer. nichnesu talmidav lenachamo. kevan sheraa otam ala laaliyyay, vealu acharav. nichnas laanpilon, nichnesu acharav. nichnas latteraklin, nichnesu acharav. amar lahem: kimdumme ani sheattem nichvim befoshrim, achshav i attem nichvim afillu bechamme chammin, lo kach shaniti lachem: avadim ushefachot en omdim alehem beshura, veen omrim alehem birkat avelim velo tanchume avelim? ella ma omrim alehem? — keshem sheomrim lo leadam al shoro veal chamoro shemmetu — "hammakom yemalle lecha chesroncha", kach omrim lo al avdo veal shifchato "hammakom yemalle lecha chesroncha".
Tanya iddach: avadim ushefachot en maspidin otan. rabbi yose omer: im eved kasher hu — omrim alav: "hoy ish tov veneeman venehene migio". amru lo: im ken, ma hinnachta lakkesherim?
Tanu rabbanan: en korin "avot" ella lishlosha, veen korin "immahot" ella learba.

Avot may tama? illema mishshum dela yadinan i meruven ka atenan i mishshimon ka atenan, i hachi immahot name la yadinan i merachel ka atenan i millea ka atenan! ella, ad hacha chashivi, tefi la chashivi.
Tanya idach: avadim ushefachot en korin otam "abba peloni" veimma pelonit". veshel rabban gamliel hayu korim otam "abba peloni" veimma pelonit".
Maase listor?! mishshum dachashivi.

Amar rabbi elazar: may dichtiv, "ken avarechcha vechayyay beshimcha essa chappay"? "ken avarechcha vechayyay" — zo keriat shema. "beshimcha essa chappay" — zo tefilla. veim ose ken — alav hakkatuv omer: "kemo chelev vadeshen tisba nafshi". velo od ella shennochel shene olamim — haolam hazze vehaolam habba, shenneemar: "vesifte renanot yehallel pi".

Rabbi elazar batar dimsayyem tzeloteh amar hachi: "yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu, shetteshakken befurenu ahava veachva veshalom vereut. vetarbe gevulenu betalmidim vetatzliach sofenu acharit vetikva. vetasim chelkenu began eden, vetakkenenu bechaver tov veyetzer tov beolamecha. venashkim venimtza yichul levavenu leyira et shemecha, vetavo lefanecha korat nafshenu letova".

Rabbi yochanan batar dimsayyem tzeloteh amar hachi: "yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu, shettatzitz bevoshtenu, vetabbit beraatenu, vetitlabbesh berachamecha, vetitkasse beuzzecha, vetitattef bachasidutecha, vetitazzer bachaninutecha, vetavo lefanecha middat tuvecha veinvetanutech".
Rabbi zera batar dimsayyem tzeloteh amar hachi: "yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu, shello necheta velo nevosh velo nikkalem meavotenu".
Rabbi chiyyay batar dimtzalle amar hachi: "yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu, shettehe toratcha ummanutenu, veal yidve libbenu, veal yechshechu enenu".

Rav batar tzeloteh amar hachi: "yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettitten lanu chayyim arukkim, chayyim shel shalom, chayyim shel tova, chayyim shel beracha, chayyim shel parnasa, chayyim shel chillutz atzamot, chayyim sheyyesh bahem yirat chet, chayyim sheen bahem busha uchelimma, chayyim shel osher vechavod, chayyim shettehe banu ahavat tora veyirat shamayim, chayyim shettemalle lanu et kol mishalot libbenu letova".

Rabbi batar tzeloteh amar hachi: "yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu, shettatztzilenu meazze panim umeazzut panim, meadam ra, umippega ra, miyyetzer ra, mechaver ra, mishshachen ra, umissatan hammashchit, umiddin kashe umibbaal din kashe, ben shehu ben berit ben sheeno ben berit".
Veaf al gav dekayymi katzotze aleh derabbi.
Rav safra batar tzeloteh amar hachi: "yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu, shettasim shalom

a: Befamalya shel mala. uvefamalya shel matta, uven hattalmidim haoskim betoratecha ben oskin lishmah ben oskin shello lishmah. vechol haoskin shello lishmah yehi ratzon sheyyehu oskin lishmah".

Rabbi alekkesanderi batar tzeloteh amar hachi: "yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu, shettaamidenu bekeren ora, veal taamidenu bekeren chashecha, veal yidve libbenu, veal yechshechu enenu". ikka deamri, ha rav hamenuna metzalle la. verabbi alekkesanderi batar dimtzalle amar hachi: "ribbon haolamim, galuy veyadua lefanecha shertzonenu laasot retzonecha, umi meakkev? — seor shebbaissa veshibud malchuyot. yehi ratzon millefanecha shettatztzilenu miyyadam, venashuv laasot chukke retzoncha belevav shalem".

Rava batar tzeloteh amar hachi: "elohay, ad shello notzarti eni keday, veachshav shennotzarti keillu lo notzarti. afar ani bechayyay, kal vachomer bemitati, hare ani lefanecha kichli male busha uchelimma. yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay, shello echeta od, uma shechatati lefanecha marek berachamecha harabbim, aval lo al yede yissurin vocholaim raim". vehayeynu vidduy derav hamenuna zute beyoma dechippure.

Mar bereh deravina ki hava mesayyem tzeloteh amar hachi: "elohay, netzor leshoni mera vesiftotay middabber mirma, velimkallelay nafshi tiddom, venafshi keafar lakkol tihye. petach libbi betoratecha, uvemitzvotecha tirdof nafshi. vetatztzileni mippega ra, miyyetzer hara, umeishsha raa, umikkol raot hammitraggeshot lavo baolam. vechol hachoshvim alay raa mehera hafer atzatam vekalkel machshevotam. yihyu leratzon imre fi vehegyon libbi lefanecha Adonai tzuri vegoali".

Rav sheshet ki hava yatev betaanita, batar dimtzalle amar hachi: "ribbon haolamim, galuy lefanecha bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, adam chote — umakriv karban. veen makrivin mimmennu, ella chelbo vedamo, umitkapper lo. veachshav yashavti betaanit venitmaet chelbi vedami, yehi ratzon millefanecha sheyyehe chelbi vedami shennitmaet keillu hikravtiv lefanecha al gabbe hammizbeach, vetirtzeni".

Rabbi yochanan ki hava mesayyem sifra deiyyov, amar hachi: "sof adam lamut vesof behema lishchita, vehakkol lemita hem omdim. ashre mi sheggadel battora vaamalo battora, veose nachat ruach leyotzro, vegadel beshem tov veniftar beshem tov min haolam, vealav amar shelomo: 'tov shem mishshemen tov veyom hammavet miyyom hivvaldo".

Margela befummeh derabbi meir: "gemor bechol levavcha uvechol nafshecha ladaat et derachay, velishkod al dalte torati. netzor torati belibbecha, veneged enecha tihye yirati. shemor pich mikkol chet, vetaher vekaddesh atzmecha mikkol ashma veavon. vaani ehye immecha bechol makom".

Margela befummayyhu derabbanan deyavne: "ani beriyya, vachaveri beriyya. ani melachti bair vehu melachto bassade. ani mashkim limlachti, vehu mashkim limlachto. keshem shehu eno mitgadder bimlachti, kach ani eni mitgadder bimlachto. veshemma tomar: ani marbe, vehu mamit — shaninu: echad hammarbe veechad hammamit uvilvad sheyyechavven libbo lashshamayim".

Margela befummeh deabbayye: leolam yehe adam arum beyira. "maane rach meshiv chema". umarbe shalom im echav veim kerovav veim kol adam vaafillu im goy bashshuk, kede sheyyehe ahuv lemala venechmad lematta, vihe mekubbal al habberiyyot.
Amru alav al rabban yochanan ben zakkay shello hikdimo adam shalom meolam, vaafillu goy bashshuk.

Margela befummeh derava: tachlit chachma — teshuva umaasim tovim, shello yehe adam kore veshone uvoet beaviv uveimmo uverabbo uvemi shehu gadol mimmennu bechachma uveminyan, shenneemar: "reshit chachma yirat Adonai sechel tov lechol osehem". "laosim" lo neemar, ella "leosehem" — laosim lishmah velo laosim shello lishmah. vechol haose shello lishmah, noach lo shello nivra.

Margela befummeh derav: lo kaolam hazze haolam habba. haolam habba en bo lo achila velo shetiyyah velo periyya ureviyya velo massa umattan velo kina velo sina velo tacharut, ella tzaddikim yoshvin veatrotehem berashehem venehenim mizziv hashshechina, shenneemar: "vayyechezu et haelohim vayyochlu vayyishtu".
Gedola havetacha shehivtichan hakkadosh baruch hu lenashim yoter min haanashim, shenneemar: "nashim shaanannot komna shemana koli banot botchot haezenna imrati".
Amar leh rav lerabbi chiyyay: nashim bemay zachyayn? beakroye benayyhu leve chenishta, uveatnoye gavrayyhu be rabbanan, venatrin legavrayyhu ad deatu mibbe rabbanan.

Ki havo mippatri rabbanan mibbe rabbi amme, veamri la mibbe rabbi chanina, amri leh hachi: "olamcha tire bechayyecha, veacharitcha lechayye haolam habba, vetikvatcha ledor dorim. libbecha yehge tevuna, picha yedabber chachmot uleshoncha yarchish renanot, afappecha yayshiru negdecha, enecha yairu bimor tora, ufanecha yazhiru kezohar harakia, siftotecha yabbiu daat, vechilyotecha taalozna mesharim, ufeamecha yarutzu lishmoa divre attik yomin".
Ki havo mippatri rabbanan mibbe rav chisda, veamri la mibbe rabbi shemuel bar nachmani, amru leh hachi: "allufenu mesubbalim vegomer".

"Allufenu mesubbalim" — rav ushemuel, veamri la rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar, chad amar: "allufenu" — battora, umesubbalim" — bemitzvot. vechad amar: "allufenu" — battora uvemitzvot, umesubbalim" — beyissurim.
b: "En peretz" — shello tehe siatenu kesiato shel david sheyyatza mimmennu achitofel. "veen yotzet" — shello tehe siatenu kesiato shel shaul sheyyatza mimmennu doeg haadomi. "veen tzevacha" — shello tehe siatenu kesiato shel elisha sheyyatza mimmennu gechazi. "birchovotenu" — shello yehe lanu ben o talmid shemmakdiach tavshilo barabbim, kegon yeshu hannotzri.

"Shimu elay abbire lev harchokim mitztzedaka", rav ushemuel, veamri la rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar. chad amar: kol haolam kullo nizzonin bitzdaka, vehem nizzonin bizroa. vechad amar: kol haolam kullo nizzonin bizchutam, vehem afillu bizchut atzman en nizzonin. kidrav yehuda amar rav.
Deamar rav yehuda amar rav: bechol yom veyom bat kol yotzet mehar chorev veomeret: kol haolam kullo nizzonin bishvil chanina beni, vachanina beni day lo bekav charuvin meerev shabbat leerev shabbat.
Ufeliga derav yehuda. deamar rav yehuda man "abbire lev" — govae tafshae. amar rav yosef: tidda, deha la iggayyayr giyyora minnayyhu.
Amar rav ashe: bene mata machseya "abbire lev" ninhu, deka chazu yekara deorayyta tere zimne beshatta, vela kamiggayyayr giyyora minnayyhu.
Chatan im rotze likrot vechulei.

Lememra derabban shimon ben gamliel chayesh leyuhara verabbanan la chayyshi leyuhara, veha ippecha shaminan lehu! ditnan: makom shennahagu laasot melacha betisha beav — osin. makom shennahagu shello laasot — en osin. vechol makom talmide chachamim betelim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: leolam yaase kol adam et atzmo ketalmid chacham.
Kashya derabbanan adderabbanan, kashya derabban shimon ben gamliel adderabban shimon ben gamliel!

Amar rabbi yochanan: muchelefet hashshita. rav shisha bereh derav idi amar: leolam lo tachlif. derabbanan adderabbanan la kashya: keriat shema, kevan dechulle alma ka karu veihu name kare — la michze keyuhara. hacha, kevan dechulle alma avdi melacha veihu la ka aved — michze keyuhara.

Derabban shimon ben gamliel adderabban shimon ben gamliel la kashya: hatam bechavvana talya milleta, vaanan sahade dela matze lechauone dateh. aval hacha, haroe omer: melacha hu deen lo. puk chazi kamma batlane ikka beshuka.
Haderan alach haya kore
Mishna mi shemmeto muttal lefanav — patur mikkeriat shema umin hattefilla umin hattefillin, umikkol mitzvot haamurot battora.

Nose hammitta vechillufehen, vechillufe chillufehen, et shellifne hammitta, veet shelleachar hammitta. et shellifne hammitta tzorech bahem — peturin, veet shelleachar hammitta tzorech bahem — chayyayvin. veellu vaellu peturim min hattefilla.
Kavru et hammet vechazru, im yecholin lehatechil veligmor ad shello yaggiu lashshura — yatchilu. veim lav — lo yatchilu.
Haomdim bashshura, happenimiyyim — peturim, vehachitzonim — chayyayvim. nashim vaavadim uketannim peturim mikkeriat shema umin hattefillin, vechayyayvin bitfilla uvimzuza uvevirkat hammazon.
Gemara muttal lefanav — in, vesheeno muttal lefanav — la.

Ureminhi: mi shemmeto muttal lefanav — ochel bevayit acher, veim en lo bayit acher — ochel bevet chavero, veim en lo bet chavero — ose mechitza veochel, veim en lo davar laasot mechitztza — machazir panav veochel. veeno mesev veochel. veeno ochel basar veeno shote yayin, veeno mevarech, veeno mezammen.

a: Veen mevarchin alav, veen mezammenin alav, ufatur mikkeriat shema umin hattefilla umin hattefillin umikkol mitzvot haamurot battora. uveshabbat mesev veochel basar veshote yayin, umevarech umezammen, umevarchin alav umezammenin alav, vechayyayv bechol hammitzvot haamurot battora. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: mittoch shennitchayyev beellu — nitchayyev bechullan.
Veamar rabbi yochanan: may benayyhu — tashmish hammitta ikka benayyhu.

Katane mihat patur mikkeriat shema umin hattefilla umin hattefillin umikkol mitzvot haamurot battora! amar rav pappa: targema ammachazir panav veochel. rav ashe amar: kevan shemmuttal alav lekovro, kemutal lefanav dame. shenneemar: "vayyakom avraham meal pene meto", veneemar: "veekbera meti millefanay", kol zeman shemmuttal alav lekovro kemutal lefanav dame.
Meto — in, aval meshammero — la.

Vehatanya: hameshammer et hammet, af al pi sheeno meto — patur mikkeriat shema umin hattefilla umin hattefillin umikkol mitzvot haamurot battora! meshammero, af al pi sheeno meto, meto af al pi sheeno meshammero.

Meto umeshammero — in, aval mehallech bevet hakkevarot — la. vehatanya: lo yehallech adam bevet hakkevarot utefillin berosho vesefer tora bizroo vekore. veim ose ken — over mishshum "loeg larash cheref osehu".
Hatam, toch arba ammot hu deasur, chutz learba ammot — chayyayv. deamar mar met tofes arba ammot likriat shema. hacha, chutz learba ammot name patur.

Gufa. hameshammer et hammet af al pi sheeno meto — patur mikkeriat shema umin hattefilla umin hattefillin umikkol mitzvot haamurot battora. hayu shenayim — ze meshammer veze kore, veze meshammer veze kore. ben azzay omer: hayu baim bisfina — mannicho bezavit zo, umitpallelin shenehem bezavit acheret.
May benayyhu? amar ravina: choshshin leachbarim ikka benayyhu. mar savar: chayyshinan. umar savar: la chayyshinan.

Tanu rabbanan: hammolich atzamot mimmakom lemakom, hare ze lo yittenem bedisakkayya veyittenem al gabbe chamor veyirkav alehem, mippene shennoheg bahem minhag bizzayon. veim haya mityare mippene goyim umippene listim — muttar. uchederech sheamru baatzamot kach amru besefer tora.
Aheyay? illema aresha — peshita! mi gara sefer tora meatzamot? ella assefa.

Amar rachava amar rav yehuda: kol haroe hammet veeno melavvehu over mishshum "loeg larash cheref osehu". veim hilvahu ma secharo? amar rav assi, alav hakkatuv omer: "malve Adonai chonen dal" "umechabbedo chonen evyon".

Rabbi chiyyay verabbi yonatan havo shakli veazli bevet hakkevarot. hava kashadya techelta derabbi yonatan. amar leh rabbi chiyyay: dalyay, keday shello yomru: lemachar bain etzlenu, veachshav mecharfin otanu.

Amar leh: umi yadi kulle hay? veha ketiv: "vehammetim enam yodim meuma"! amar leh: im karita — lo shanita. im shanita — lo shillashta. im shillashta — lo pershu lecha. "ki hachayyim yodim sheyyamutu" — ellu tzaddikim shebbemitatan nikreu chayyim, shenneemar: "uvenayahu ven yehoyada ben ish chay rav pealim mikkavtzeel hu hikka et shene ariel moav vehu yarad vehikka et haari betoch habbor beyom hashshaleg".
b: "Ben ish chay": attu kulle alma bene mete ninhu? ella: "ben ish chay" — sheafillu bemitato karuy chay. "rav pealim mikkavtzeel" — sheribba vekibbetz poalim lattora. "vehu hikka et shene ariel moav" — shello hinniach kemoto lo bemikdash rishon velo bemikdash sheni.
"Vehu yarad vehikka et haari betoch habbor beyom hashshaleg", ikka deamri: detabbar gezize devarda, unechat uteval. ikka deamri: ditna sifra deve rav beyoma desitva.

"Vehammetim enam yodim meuma" — ellu reshaim, shebbechayyehen keruyin "metim", shenneemar: "veatta chalal rasha nesi yisrael". vei baet ema, mehacha: "al pi shenayim edim o al pi shelosha edim yumat hammet", chay hu! ella, hammet meikkara.

Bene rabbi chiyyay nefuk lekiryayta. iyyakkar lehu talmudayyhu. havo ka mitztzaari leiddechoreh. amar leh chad lechavreh: yada avun behay tzaara? amar leh iddach: mena yada? veha ketiv: "yichbedu vanav velo yeda".
Amar leh iddach: vela yada? veha ketiv: "ach besaro alav yichav venafsho alav teeval". veamar rabbi yitzchak: kasha rimma lammet kemachat babbasar hachay!
Amri: betzaara didhu — yadi, betzaara deacharina — la yadi.

Vela? vehatanya: maase bechasid echad shennatan dinar leani beerev rosh hashshana bishne vatztzoret, vehiknitattu ishto, vehalach velan bevet hakkevarot. veshama shete ruchot shemsapperot zo lazo. amra chada lachavertah: chaverti, boi venashut baolam, venishma meachore happargod ma pureanut ba laolam? amra lah chavertah: eni yechola, sheani kevura bemachtzelet shel kanim. ella lechi at, uma sheat shomaat imri li. halcha hi veshata uvaa. veamra lah chavertah: chaverti, ma shamat meachore happargod? amra lah: shamati shekkol hazzorea birvia rishona barad malke oto. halach hu vezara birvia sheniyya. shel kol haolam kullo laka, shello — lo laka.

Lashshana haacheret halach velan bevet hakkevarot, veshama otan shete ruchot shemsapperot zo im zo. amra chada lachavertah: boi venashut baolam venishma meachore happargod ma pureanut ba laolam. amra lah: chaverti, lo kach amarti lach, eni yechola sheani kevura bemachtzelet shel kanim?! ella lechi at, uma sheat shomaat boi veimri li. halcha veshata uvaa. veamra lah chavertah: chaverti, ma shamat meachore happargod? amra lah: shamati shekkol hazzorea birvia sheniyya shiddafon malke oto. halach vezara birvia rishona, shel kol haolam kullo nishdaf veshello lo nishdaf.

Amra lo ishto: mippene ma eshtakad shel kol haolam kullo laka veshellecha lo laka, veachshav shel kol haolam kullo nishdaf veshellecha lo nishdaf? sach lah kol haddevarim hallalu. amru: lo hayu yamim muatim ad shennafla ketata ben ishto shel oto chasid uven immah shel otah riva. amra lah: lechi vearech bittech shehi kevura bemachtzelet shel kanim.

Lashshana haacheret halach velan bevet hakkevarot veshama otan ruchot shemsapperot zo im zo. amra lah: chaverti, boi venashut baolam venishma meachore happargod ma pureanut ba laolam. amra lah: chaverti, hanichini, devarim shebbeni levenech kevar nishmeu ben hachayyim. alma yadi.
Dilma inish acharina shachev, veazel veamar lehu.

Ta shema: dizeri hava mafked zuze gabbe ushepizchateh. ad deate veazel leve rav, shechiva. azal batra lachatzar mavet, amar la: zuze hecha? amara leh: zil shaklinhu mittute tzinnora dedasha beduch pelan, veema la leimma, teshaddar li masrekay veguvetay dechuchela bahade pelanita deatya limchar. alma yadi!
Dilma duma kadem umachrez lehu.

Ta shema: daavu dishmuel havo ka mafkedi gabbeh zuze deyatme. ki nach nafsheh la hava shemuel gabbeh. havo ka karu leh: "bar achel zuze deyatme". azal abbatreh lachatzar mavet. amar lehu: baena abba! amaru leh: abba tuva ikka hacha. amar lehu: baena abba bar abba. amaru leh: abba bar abba name tuva ikka hacha. amar lehu: baena abba bar abba avu dishmuel hecha? amaru leh selek limtivta dirkia. addehachi chazyeh lelevi deyatev abbaray. amar leh: ammay yatvat abbaray? may tama la salkat? amar leh, deamri li: kol ki hanach shene dela selekt limtivta derabbi appas veachleshteh ledateh, la meayyeylinan lach limtivta dirkia.

Addehachi vehachi ata avu, chazyeh dahava ka vache veachech. amar leh: may tama ka vachet? amar leh: delaagal ka atet. may tama achecht? dachashivat behay alma tuva. amar leh: i chashivna — neayyeylu lelevi. veayyeyluhu lelevi.

Amar leh: zuze deyatme hecha? amar leh: zil shaklinhu beamta derichya. illae vetattae — didan, umitze deyatme. amar leh: may tama avadt hachi? amar leh: i ganvi gannave — migganvu middidan. i achla ara — achla middidan. alma deyadi! — dilma shane shemuel, kevan dachashiv kadmi umachrezi: pannu makom.

Veaf rabbi yonatan hadar beh, deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: minnayin lammetim shemsapperim ze im ze — shenneemar: "vayyomer Adonai elav zot haaretz asher nishbati leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov lemor". may "lemor"? — amar hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: lech emor lahem leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov: shevua shennishbati lachem kevar kiyyamtiha livnechem.

a: Vei salka datach dela yadi, ki amar lehu may have? ella may — deyadi? lema leh lememar lehu?! leachzoke leh tevuta lemoshe.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: kol hamesapper achare hammet, keillu mesapper achare haeven. ikka deamri dela yadi, veikka deamri deyadi vela ichpat lehu.
Ini?! veha amar rav pappa: chad ishtai milleta batreh demar shemuel unefal kanya mittelala uvezaa learneka democheh!
Shane tzorva merabbanan, dekudesha berich hu tava bikareh.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol hamesapper achar mittatan shel talmide chachamim nofel begehinnam, shenneemar: "vehammattim akalkallotam yolichem Adonai et poale haaven shalom al yisrael". afillu beshaa sheshshalom al yisrael, "yolichem Adonai et poale haaven".

Tana deve rabbi yishmael: im raita talmid chacham sheavar avera ballayla — al teharher acharav bayyom, shemma asa teshuva. "shemma" salka datach? ella vadday asa teshuva. vehane mille — bidvarim shebbegufo. aval bemamona — ad demahdar lemareh.
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: beesrim vearbaa mekomot bet din menaddin al kevod harav, vechullan shaninu bemishnatenu. amar leh rabbi elazar: hecha? amar leh: lechi tashkach.
Nefak dak, veashkach telat: hamezalzel bintilat yadayim, vehamesapper achar mittatan shel talmide chachamim, vehammegis dato kelappe mala.

"Hamesapper achar mittatan shel talmide chachamim" may hi? — ditnan: hu haya omer: en mashkin lo et haggiyyoret, velo et hameshuchereret. vachachamim omrim: mashkin. veamru lo: maase becharkemit, shifcha meshuchereret birushalayim vehishkuha shemaya veavtalyon! veamar lahem: dugema hishkuha — venidduhu umet benidduyo, vesaklu bet din et arono.

"Vehamezalzel bintilat yadayim" may hi? — ditnan, amar rabbi yehuda: chas veshalom sheakavya ben mahalalel nitnadda, sheen azara ninelet al kol adam beyisrael bechochma uvetohora uveyirat chet kaakavya ben mahalalel. ella et mi niddu? — et elazar ben chanoch sheppikpek bintilat yadayim. ucheshemmet, shalchu bet din vehinnichu even gedola al arono, lelammedcha shekkol hammitnadde umet benidduyo — bet din soklin et arono.

"Hammegis dato kelappe mala" may hi? — ditnan, shalach lo shimon ben shetach lechoni hameaggel: tzarich atta lehitnaddot, veilmale choni atta gozrani alecha nidduy, aval ma eese sheatta mitchatte lifne hammakom veose lecha retzoncha, keven shemmitchatte lifne aviv veose lo retzono. vealecha hakkatuv omer: "yismach avicha veimmecha vetagel yoladtecha".

Vetu lekka? veha ikka detane rav yosef: todos ish romi hinhig et bene romi lehaachilan gedayim mekullasin belele pesachim. shelach leh shimon ben shatach: ilmale todos atta, gozrani alecha nidduy, sheatta maachil et yisrael kodashim bachutz.
"Bemishnatenu" kaamrinan. veha, barayyta hi.
Uvematnitin lekka? veha ikka ha ditnan: chatacho chuleyot venatan chol ben chuleya lechuleya — rabbi eliezer metaher, vachachamim metammeim. vezehu tannuro shel achnay.
May "achnay"? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: melammed shehikkifuhu halachot keachnay ze, vetimmeuhu.
Vetanya: oto hayyom heviu kol teharot shettiher rabbi eliezer userafum lefanav, ulevassof berchuhu.
Afillu hachi, nidduy bematnitin la tenan. ella "beesrim vearbaa mekomot" hecha mashkachat la? rabbi yehoshua ben levi medamme milleta lemilleta, verabbi elazar la medamme milleta lemilleta.
Nose hammitta vechillufehen. tanu rabbanan en motziin et hammet samuch likriat shema. veim hitchilu — en mafsikin. ini?! veha rav yosef appekuhu samuch likriat shema! adam chashuv shane.

Shellifne hammitta veshelleachar hammitta. tanu rabbanan: haoskim behesped, bizman shehammet mutal lifnehem nishmatin echad echad vekorin. en hammet mutal lifnehem, hen yoshvin vekorin, vehu yoshev vedomem. hem omdim umitpallelin, vehu omed umatzdik alav et haddin, veomer: "ribbon haolamim, harebe chatati lefanecha, velo nifrata mimmenni echad minni elef, yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu, shettigdor pirtzotenu ufirtzot kol ammecha bet yisrael berachamim".
Amar abbaye: la mibbee leh leinash lememar hachi, deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish, vechen tana mishshemeh derabbi yose: leolam al yiftach adam piv lassatan.
Veamar rav yosef: may keraa — shenneemar: "kimat kisdom hayinu", may ahadar lehu navi — "shimu devar Adonai ketzine sedom".

Kavru et hammet vechazru vechulei. im yecholim lehatechil veligmor et kullah in, aval perek echad o pasuk echad — la. ureminhu: kavru et hammet vechazru, im yecholin lehatechil veligmor afillu perek echad o pasuk echad!
Hachi name kaamar: im yecholin lehatechil veligmor afillu perek echad o afillu pasuk echad ad shello yaggiu lashshura — yatchilu, veim lav — lo yatchilu.
b: Haomdim bashshura vechulei. tanu rabbanan: shura haroa penima — petura, vesheenah roa penima — chayyevet. rabbi yehuda omer: habbaim mechamat haavel — peturin, mechamat atzman — chayyayvin.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: hammotze kilayim bevigdo — poshtan afillu bashshuk. may tama: "en chochma veen tevuna veen etza leneged Adonai", kol makom sheyyesh chillul hashshem en cholkin kavod larav.

Metivi: kavru et hammet vechazru, velifnehem shete derachim, achat tehora veachat temea, ba battehora — bain immo battehora, ba battemea — bain immo battemea mishshum kevodo. ammay? lema "en chochma veen tevuna leneged Adonai"!
Targema rabbi abba bevet happeras derabbanan.
Deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: menappeach adam bet happeras veholech. veamar rav yehuda bar ashe mishshemeh derav: bet happeras shenniddash — tahor.

Ta shema deamar rabbi elazar bar tzadok: medallegin hayinu al gabbe aronot shel metim, likrat malche yisrael. velo likrat malche yisrael bilvad amru ella afillu likrat malche ummot haolam, sheim yizke, yavchin ben malche yisrael lemalche ummot haolam. ammay? lema "en chochma veen tevuna veen etza leneged Adonai"!
Kidrava. deamar rava: devar tora, ohel, kol sheyyesh bo chalal tefach — chotzetz bifne hattumea. vesheen bo chalal tefach — eno chotzetz bifne hattumea.
Verov aronot yesh bahen chalal tefach. vegazru al sheyyesh bahen mishshum sheen bahen. umishshum kevod melachim la gezaru behu rabbanan.
Ta shema: gadol kevod habberiyyot sheddoche [et] lo taase shebbattora.
Veammay? lema "en chochma veen tevuna veen etza leneged Adonai"! targema rav bar sheva kammeh derav kahana belav delo tasur". achichu aleh, lav delo tasur" deorayyta hi?!
Amar rav kahana: gavra rabba amar milleta, la techichu aleh. kol mille derabbanan asmechinhu al lav delo tasur", umishshum kevodo shero rabbanan.
Ta shema: "vehitallamta mehem" — peamim sheatta mitallem mehem, ufeamim sheen atta mitallem mehem.

Ha ketzad? im haya kohen, vehi bevet hakkevarot, o haya zaken veenah lefi chevodo, o shehayta melachto merubba mishshel chavero, lechach neemar "vehitallamta". ammay, lema "en chochma veen tevuna veen etza leneged Adonai"!
Shane hatam, dichtiv "vehitallamta mehem". veligmar minna? issura mimmamona la yalfinan.
Ta shema.
"Uleachoto" ma talmud lomar? hare shehaya holech lishchot et pischo, velamul et beno, veshama shemmet lo met, yachol yachzor veyittamma? — amarta: lo yittamma.
Yachol: keshem sheeno mittamme lahem kach eno mittamme lemet mitzva — talmud lomar "uleachoto" — laachoto hu deeno mittamme,

a: Aval mittamme hu lemet mitzva. ammay, lema: "en chochma veen tevuna veen etza leneged Adonai"!
Shane hatam, dichtiv "velaachoto".
Veligmar minna! shev veal taase shane.

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: may shena rishonim deitrechish lehu nissa, umay shena anan dela mitrechish lan nissa? i mishshum tannoye, bishne derav yehuda kulle tannoye binzikin hava, vaanan ka matninan shitta sidre. vechi hava mate rav yehuda beuketzin, haishsha shekkoveshet yarak bakkedera, veamri la zetim shekkevashan betarfehen tehorim, amar: havayot derav ushemuel ka chazena hacha. vaanan ka matninan beuketzin telesar metivata, veillu rav yehuda ki hava shalef chad mesaneh, ate mitra, vaanan ka metzaarinan nafshin umitzvach ka tzavchinan, velet demashgach ban.

Amar leh: kammae havo ka masri nafshayyhu akkedushshat hashshem, anan la masrinan nafshin akkedushshat hashshem. ki ha derav adda bar ahava chazyay lehahi kutit dahavat levisha karbalta beshuka. sevar devat yisrael hi, kam kareh minna. iggallay milleta dechutit hi. shayyeymuha bearba mea zuze. amar la: ma shemich? amara leh: matun. amar la, matun — matun arba mea zuze shavya.

Rav giddel hava regil dahava ka azel veyatev ashshaare ditvila. amar lehu: hachi tevilu vehachi tevilu. amri leh rabbanan la ka mistefe mar miyyetzer hara? amar lehu: damyayn beappay ki kake chivvare.

Rabbi yochanan hava regil dahava ka azel veyatev ashshaare ditvila. amar: ki salkan benot yisrael veatyayn mittevila, mistakkelan bi, veneheve lehu zara deshappire kevoti. amri leh rabbanan: la ka mistefe mar meena bisha? amar lehu: ana mizzara deyosef ka atena, dela shalta beh ena bisha, dichtiv "ben porat yosef ben porat ale ayin", veamar rabbi avahu: al tikre "ale ayin", ella "ole ayin".
Rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar mehacha: "veyidgu larov bekerev haaretz", ma dagim shebbayyam mayim mechassin alehem veen ayin hara sholetet bahem, af zaro shel yosef en ayin hara sholetet bahem.
Vei baet ema: ayin shello ratzta lizzon mimma sheeno shello — en ayin hara sholetet bo.
Mishna nashim vaavadim uketannim peturin mikkeriat shema
b: Umin hattefillin, vechayyayvin bitfilla uvimzuza uvevirkat hammazon.
Gemara keriat shema: peshita! mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama hu, vechol mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama nashim peturot?
Mahu detema: hoil veit ba malchut shamayim, kamashma lan.
Umin hattefillin. peshita! mahu detema: hoil veittakkash limzuza — kamashma lan.
Vechayyayvin bitfilla. derachame ninhu. mahu detema: hoil uchetiv ba "erev vavoker vetzohorayim", kemitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama dame — kamashma lan.
Uvimzuza. peshita! mahu detema: hoil veittakkash letalmud tora — kamashma lan.
Uvevirkat hammazon. peshita! mahu detema hoil uchetiv "betet Adonai lachem baerev basar leechol velechem babboker lisboa", kemitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama dame — kamashma lan.
Amar rav adda bar ahava: nashim chayyayvot bekiddush hayyom devar tora. ammay? mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama hu, vechol mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama nashim peturot! amar abbaye: midderabbanan.
Amar leh rava: veha "devar tora" kaamar. veod, kol mitzvat ase nechayyeyvinhu midderabbanan!
Ella amar rava: amar kera "zachor veshamor" — kol sheyyeshno bishmira yeshno bizchira. vehane neshe hoil veitanhu bishmira, itanhu bizchira.

Amar leh ravina lerava: nashim bevirkat hammazon, deorayyta o derabbanan? lemay nafka minna — leappoke rabbim yede chovatan. i amrat bishlama deorayyta, ate deorayyta umappek deorayyta. ella i amrat derabbanan, have "sheeno mechuyyayv baddavar", vechol sheeno mechuyyayv baddavar eno motzi et harabbim yede chovatan. may?
Ta shema: beemet amru ben mevarech leaviv veeved mevarech lerabbo veishsha mevarechet levaalah, aval amru chachamim: tavo meera leadam sheishto uvanav mevarchin lo.
I amrat bishlama deorayyta, ate deorayyta umappek deorayyta. ella i amrat derabbanan, ate derabbanan umappek deorayyta?!
Uletamaych katan bar chiyyuva hu? ella hacha bemay askinan — kegon sheachal shiura derabbanan, deate derabbanan umappek derabbanan.

Daresh rav avvira, zimnin amar la mishshemeh derabbi amme vezimnin amar la mishshemeh derabbi assi: amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, katuv betoratecha "asher lo yissa fanim velo yikkach shochad", vahalo atta nose panim leyisrael, dichtiv: "yissa Adonai panav elecha"?! amar lahem: vechi lo essa panim leyisrael, shekkatavti lahem battora "veachalta vesavata uverachta et Adonai elohecha", vehem medakdekim [al] atzmam ad kezayit vead kevetza.
Mishna baal keri — mehareher belibbo, veeno mevarech, lo lefaneha velo leachareha. veal hammazon mevarech leacharav veeno mevarech lefanav. rabbi yehuda omer: mevarech lifnehem uleacharehem.
Gemara amar ravina: zot omeret hirhur kedibbur dame. dei salka datach lav kedibbur dame — lamma mehareher?
Ella may — hirhur kedibbur dame, yotzi bisfatav?
Kidashkechan besinay.
Verav chisda amar, hirhur lav kedibbur dame, dei salka datach hirhur kedibbur dame — yotzi bisfatav.
Ella may hirhur lav kedibbur dame, lamma mehareher? amar rabbi elazar: kede shello yehu kol haolam oskin bo vehu yoshev uvatel.
Venigros befirka acharina! amar rav adda bar ahava: bedavar shehatztzibbur oskin bo.

a: Vahare tefilla, dedavar shehatztzibbur asukin bo, utenan: haya omed bitfilla venizkar shehu baal keri — lo yafsik, ella yekatztzer. tama deatchel, ha la atchel — lo yatchil!

Shane tefilla delet ba malchut shamayim. vahare birkat hammazon leacharav delet ba malchut shamayim, utenan al hammazon mevarech leacharav veeno mevarech lefanav! ella: keriat shema uvirkat hammazon deorayyta, utefilla derabbanan.
Amar rav yehuda: minnayin levirkat hammazon leachareha min hattora — shenneemar: "veachalta vesavata uverachta".
Minnayin levirkat hattora lefaneha min hattora — shenneemar: "ki shem Adonai ekra havu godel lelohenu".

Amar rabbi yochanan: lamadnu birkat hattora leachareha min birkat hammazon mikkal vachomer, uvirkat hammazon lefaneha min birkat hattora mikkal vachomer. birkat hattora leachareha min birkat hammazon mikkal vachomer: uma mazon sheen taun lefanav, taun leacharav, tora shetteuna lefaneha, eno din shetteuna leachareha. uvirkat hammazon lefaneha min birkat hattora mikkal vachomer: uma tora sheen teuna leachareha, teuna lefaneha, mazon shehu taun leacharav, eno din sheyyehe taun lefanav.
Ikka lemifrach: ma lemazon shekken nehene. uma letora shekken chayye olam. veod, tenan al hammazon mevarech leacharav veeno mevarech lefanav. teyuveta.

Amar rav yehuda: safek kara keriat shema, safek lo kara — eno chozer vekore. safek amar "emet veyatztziv", safek lo amar — chozer veomer "emet veyatztziv". may tama? — keriat shema derabbanan. "emet veyatztziv", deorayyta.
Metiv rav yosef: "uveshachbecha uvekumecha". amar leh abbaye: hahu bedivre tora ketiv.
Tenan: baal keri mehareher belibbo veeno mevarech lo lefaneha velo leachareha. veal hammazon mevarech leacharav veeno mevarech lefanav.
Vei salka datach "emet veyatztziv" deorayyta — livroch leachareha!
May tama mevarech, i mishshum yetziat mitzrayim — ha adkar leh bikriat shema.
Venema ha vela live ha! keriat shema adifa, deit ba tarte.

Verabbi elazar amar: safek kara keriat shema safek lo kara — chozer vekore keriat shema. safek hitpallel safek lo hitpallel — eno chozer umitpallel. verabbi yochanan amar: ulevay sheyyitpallel adam kol hayyom kullo.

Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: haya omed bitfilla venizkar shehitpallel posek — vaafillu beemtza beracha. ini?! vehaamar rav nachman: ki havenan be rabba bar avu, bean minneh: hane bene ve rav detau umadkeri dechol beshabbat, mahu sheyyigmeru? vaamar lan: gomrin kol otah beracha?!
Hachi hasheta! hatam gavra bar chiyyuva hu, verabbanan hu dela atrechuhu mishshum kevod shabbat, aval hacha — ha tzalli leh.
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hitpallel venichnas levet hakkeneset umatza tzibbur shemmitpallelin, im yachol lechaddesh bah davar — yachzor veyitpallel, veim lav — al yachzor veyitpallel.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan kammayyta, hane mille yachid veyachid
b: O tzibbur vetzibbur, aval yachid legabbe tzibbur keman dela tzalli dame, kamashma lan. vei ashmeinan hacha, mishshum dela atchel ba, aval hatam deatchel ba — ema la. tzericha.

Amar rav huna: hannichnas levet hakkeneset umatza tzibbur shemmitpallelin, im yachol lehatechil veligmor ad shello yaggia sheliach tzibbur lemodim" — yitpallel. veim lav — al yitpallel. rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: im yachol lehatechil veligmor ad shello yaggia sheliach tzibbur likdushsha" — yitpallel, veim lav — al yitpallel.
Bemay ka mippalgi — mar savar yachid omer "kedushsha", umar savar en yachid omer "kedushsha".
Vechen amar rav adda bar ahava: minnayin sheen hayyachid omer "kedushsha" — shenneemar: "venikdashti betoch bene yisrael", kol davar shebbikdushsha lo yehe pachot measara.

May mashma? detane ravnay achu derabbi chiyyay bar abba: atya "toch" "toch". ketiv hacha: "venikdashti betoch bene yisrael", uchetiv hatam: "hibbadlu mittoch haeda hazzot", ma lehallan asara. af kan asara.
Udechulle alma mihat mifsak la pasek.

Ibbaya lehu: mahu lehafesik lihe shemo haggadol mevorach"? ki ata rav dimi, amar: rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon talmide derabbi yochanan amri: lakkol en mafsikin chutz min "yehe shemo haggadol mevorach". sheafillu osek bemaase merkava — posek. velet hilcheta kevateh.

Rabbi yehuda omer mevarech lifnehem uleacharehem. lememra dekasavar rabbi yehuda baal keri muttar bedivre tora? vehaamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, minnayin levaal keri sheasur bedivre tora — shenneemar: "vehodatam levanecha velivne vanecha", usemich leh: "yom asher amadta vegomer". ma lehallan baale kerayin asurin, af kan baale kerayin asurin!

Vechi tema rabbi yehuda la daresh "semuchim", vehaamar rav yosef: afillu man dela daresh semuchim bechol hattora, bemishne tora — daresh. deha rabbi yehuda la daresh "semuchin" bechol hattora kullah uvemishne tora — daresh.

Uvechol hattora kullah mena lan dela daresh — detanya, ben azzay omer: neemar "mechashshefa lo techayye", veneemar "kol shochev im behema mot yumat" — semacho inyan lo, lomar: ma shochev im behema biskila, af mechashshefa name biskila.

Amar lo rabbi yehuda: vechi mippene shessemacho inyan lo, notzi laze liskila? ella: ov veyiddeoni bichlal kol hamechashshefim hayu, velamma yatzu — lehakkish lahen velomar lach: ma ov veyiddeoni biskila — af mechashshefa biskila.
Uvemishne tora mena lan dedaresh — detanya: rabbi eliezer omer nose adam anusat aviv umefuttat aviv anusat beno umefuttat beno.

Rabbi yehuda oser baanusat aviv uvimfuttat aviv. veamar rav giddel amar rav: may tama derabbi yehuda? — dichtiv: "lo yikkach ish et eshet aviv velo yegalle et kenaf aviv". kanaf sheraa aviv — lo yegalle.
Umimmay devaanusat aviv ketiv — dismich leh: "venatan haish hashshochev immah vegomer".

Amri: in bemishne tora daresh, vehane semuchin mibbee leh leidach derabbi yehoshua ben levi. deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol hamelammed livno tora maale alav hakkatuv keillu kibbelah mehar chorev. shenneemar: "vehodatam levanecha velivne vanecha", uchetiv batreh "yom asher amadta lifne Adonai elohecha bechorev".
Tenan zav sheraa keri, venidda sheppalta shichvat zera, hameshammeshet veraata dam, tzerichin tevila. verabbi yehuda poter.
Ad kan lo patar rabbi yehuda ella bezav sheraa keri, demeikkara lav bar tevila hu, aval baal keri gereda mechayyayv.

Vechi tema: hu haddin daafillu baal keri gereda name patar rabbi yehuda, vehay deka mippallegi bezav sheraa keri — lehodiacha kochan derabbanan. ema sefa: hameshammeshet veraata dam — tzericha tevila.

Leman katane la? illema lerabbanan — peshita! hasheta uma zav sheraa keri — demeikkara lav bar tevila hu, mechayyeyvi rabbanan; hameshammeshet veraata dam — demeikkara bat tevila hi, lo kol shekken?! ella lav rabbi yehuda hi, vedavka katane la,
